jobs.title: Program Coordinator II
jobs.description:
**About Abode:**



At **Abode**, we believe everyone deserves a safe and stable place to call home. Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths. When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.


**Our Values:**



We start with dignity, take smart risks, be transparent, solve for today and tomorrow, and spark each other’s strengths in everything we do!


**The Diverse Culture:**



We believe that we make better decisions and provide quality services when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. People of color make up nearly 70% of our workforce and we strive to recruit and retain employees from all backgrounds.


**About The Role**: The Program Coordinator will supervise the provision of services to program participants in the County, through direct staff supervision of staff.


**How You Make An Impact**:


* Provide supervision and leadership and supervision to the assigned team.
* Participate in county wide meetings, provide feedback on successes and necessary system re\-designs.
* Engage in on\-going tracking and evaluation of program goals and effectiveness.
* Provide support to staff when dealing with client crises and problem solving with managers on challenging participant situations.
* Provide feedback, coaching training, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Work with staff to ensure in real time and accurate data entry is occurring.
* Work with Data Specialists on reporting to funders and stakeholders on program activities.
* Monitor assigned employee’s contacts with participants to ensure maximization of funding and program deliverables are met.
* Facilitate case conferencing and administrative meetings.
* Develop materials, assessment tools, job descriptions, and other program processes/documents/tools.
* Develop program policy and procedures, services delivery, and other aspects of the program.
* Other duties as assigned.


**How You Meet Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in psychology, Human Services, Social Work, Sociology, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3 years of professional experience in the human services, social work, or related field and demonstrated experience working collaboratively with low\-income families.
* 1 year of direct experience in the provision and supervision of services to individuals who are homeless and/or have extremely low incomes.
* Flexible schedule to work evening and weekend hours as needed.
* Use of personal vehicle and proof of a valid and current California Driver’s License and current insurance along with a clean DMV record required.


COMPETENCIES:


* Excellent verbal \& written communication, organizational, and time management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to work well independently and collaboratively with teams.
* Strong ability to represent the interests of the agency, interact effectively with a diverse population with multiple special needs, and be comfortable building successful collaborative relationships with tenants, staff, and with community networking and resource building.
* Must have a working knowledge of Psychiatric Disorders.
* Knowledge and ability to implement the following evidence\-based models, Psychosocial Rehabilitation, Harm Reduction, and Motivational Interviewing.
* Experience in building supportive and respectful working relationships with participants and staff.
* Practice and knowledge of culturally sensitive components of direct service delivery through open dialogs and self\-exploration with diverse groups.
* Experienced in effectively intervening in crisis situations using de\-escalation techniques.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, systems, and platforms.
* Ability to learn and use required mobile devices and business\-related applications.
* Outstanding communication skills and high degree of emotional intelligence, cultural humility, with a proven track record to build and maintain effective relationships with a wide variety of internal and external contacts.


**Our Benefits and Perks:**


* **Competitive Pay**: $75,000\.00\-$92,000\.00 (DOE)
* **Classification:** Full Time/Exempt
* **Work Arrangement**: Onsite position; Tuesday through Friday 12:00 PM\- 8:00 PM, Saturday 9\-5
* **PTO**:19 days per year, increasing with tenure
* **Holidays**: 12 paid holidays per year
* **Health \& Wellness**:
	+ 100% medical, dental and vision coverage options for employees
	+ Agency dependent health care contribution
	+ Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
	+ Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
	+ Retirement Plan: 403(b) Plan w/ Employer Match \& Contribution Programs
* **Voluntary Benefits**:
	+ Commuter Assistance
	+ Life Insurance
	+ Legal Services
* **Mission Driven Culture**: Join a team that's passionate about making a meaningful impact in the fight to end homelessness.

jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives!**

We're looking for a **Program Coordinator** for the **San Jose, CA area!**

**Specifics:**

* **Official Job Title:** Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non\-Exempt, 10 hours per week
* **Job Location:** San Jose, CA
* **Pay rate:** $21\.00 ph
* **Skills:** Experience working with youth ages 5 through 17; small\- and large\-group classroom management skills; excellent communication and organizational abilities.

**Our Philosophy**

**LifeSTEPS** is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services. The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for “**S**kills **T**raining and **E**ducational **P**rograms” and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by LifeSTEPS will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.




**About us**


LifeSTEPS, is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit charitable organization. It was founded in 1996 and currently has over 440 partnered affordable housing properties all over the state of California. We serve several regions from Sacramento, Bay Area, South Bay, Central Valley, LA County and Inland Pacific regions. We work with 115,000 residents all over the state and we’re on a mission to provide effective educational and supportive services to maximize the strengths of individuals and build resilient communities.




**Our Benefits**


In addition to meeting your passion for making a difference in the lives of those we serve, all employees will receive the following benefits:

* Competitive pay based on skill and experience
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Sick Leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* LifeSTEPS Perks Program


Benefit eligible employees working 30 hours per week or more will also receive:

* Medical, Dental Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Identity Theft Program
* Pet Insurance
* Paid Time Off




**About the Position**


The **Program Coordinator,** under the direction of the Regional Director of Social Services, is expected to design, implement, and coordinate activities and programs within assigned affordable housing complexes. This position works closely with the Director of Social Services (DSS) to provide the highest quality of service to the residents served by LifeSTEPS.




**Core Duties** **Program Coordinator**


* Empower children from low\-income and underserved families to flourish by providing after\-school education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go after school to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Education and/or Experience and/or License Certification:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Two (2\) years of experience in a similar environment providing services.
* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, or related field preferred.
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required




Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support individuals and families so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? Apply today!!!




**Please Note**

***LifeSTEPS values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity at LifeSTEPS means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognized, appreciated, respected, and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilize each person's talents and strengths. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, disability, age or covered veteran status. jobs.title: Office Manager, San Francisco
jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go\-to\-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1\.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

**About the Role**
------------------



Apollo is opening a new office in San Francisco, and we're looking for an Office Manager to own the day\-to\-day operations of the space. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, this person will make sure the office is safe, welcoming, and productive, from front\-of\-house hospitality to vendor coordination to onboarding logistics.



This role is about more than keeping the lights on. You will bring structure and follow\-through to a growing office, working closely with the Chief of Staff, IT Team, and People Team to keep operations running smoothly as the team scales. You will set the tone for anyone who walks through the door, whether that is a new hire on day one or a visiting executive.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail oriented, and genuinely enjoys creating a great workplace experience. You are just as comfortable managing vendors and logistics as you are greeting a visitor with a warm welcome.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Office Operations \& Vendor Management**


* Support the day\-to\-day operations of the office environment to ensure it remains safe, welcoming, and productive.
* Collaborate with the Chief of Staff to implement office policies, coordinate logistics, and support company initiatives.
* Coordinate with building management and approved vendors, including maintenance, cleaning, snacks, and supplies, under guidance from the Chief of Staff.
* Maintain inventory of office supplies and oversee restocking of all common areas.
* Report and follow up on facility maintenance issues, working closely with building management and approved vendors. Obtain a minimum of three invoices or quotes per service, per policy.
* Coordinate vendors and contractors end to end: schedule the work, follow through, and catch issues before they become visible problems.

### **Workplace Experience, Onboarding \& Events**


* Greet visitors and ensure a smooth check\-in experience that reflects Apollo's brand and hospitality standards.
* Manage badge and access administration, including access for visitors, card deactivation, and a monthly review of active access cards.
* Own onsite onboarding activities and office onboarding logistics in collaboration with IT and People Ops, including welcome and orientation touchpoints.
* Help coordinate in\-office events, employee recognition moments, and team gatherings with direction from the Chief of Staff.
* Maintain organization and daily presentation of communal spaces such as kitchens, conference rooms, and shared desks.

### **Health, Safety \& Compliance**


* Assist in safety procedures and help coordinate office readiness, such as fire drills and ergonomic checks.
* Ensure signage, office protocols, and emergency materials are maintained and up to date.
* Act as a point of contact during minor incidents or office\-related disruptions, escalating appropriately to building management and leadership.
* Work closely with Apollo's safety and compliance stakeholders on any office\-related safety requests.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------



In this role, success means:


* The office runs smoothly day to day, and issues are resolved before they become disruptions.
* Vendors and building management are handled proactively, with clear documentation and cost discipline.
* New hires have a welcoming first day, and visitors leave with a strong impression of Apollo.
* The Chief of Staff, IT, and People Team all consider this person a reliable partner.
* Office events and team moments feel organized and well executed.
* Safety protocols and compliance requirements are consistently met.

**What You Bring**
------------------


* 3 to 5 years of experience in administrative, office management, workplace operations, hospitality, or facilities coordination roles.
* Experience supporting an in\-office team in a startup or corporate environment.
* **Organization:** Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple requests at once.
* **Communication:** Clear, friendly communication style, written and verbal, with a service\-oriented, hospitality mindset.
* **Follow\-through:** Proven ability to follow processes, stay on top of logistical details, and own assigned responsibilities.
* **Vendor management:** Working knowledge of vendor coordination, invoices, and budget review.
* Comfortable using tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, calendar management software, and ticketing or help desk platforms.
* Comfortable using AI tools to boost day\-to\-day productivity, such as drafting and summarizing, and able to critically assess AI\-generated content.
* Full\-time, on\-site availability in San Francisco, five days a week.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------



You may be a strong fit if you are:


* Someone who sets a warm, professional tone for anyone entering the office.
* Proactive and solutions\-focused, comfortable anticipating needs in a fast\-paced, changing environment.

jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.  



**Our Team**
------------

Netflix’s Content \& Business Products (CBP) department builds and buys technology that helps create, plan, produce, promote, and distribute the content our subscribers enjoy on the Netflix streaming service. We partner with cross\-functional teams to develop cutting\-edge solutions that are revolutionizing the entertainment industry.


The Product Directors \& Managers in CBP need to (1\) plan, prioritize, and execute across multiple product domains; (2\) align with multiple sets of business stakeholders; and (3\) connect their work to the broader product organization. To support these three altitudes of work, the CBP Operations team provides tactical support to relieve operational overhead.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager, Implementation & Accounts - Hospital Billing
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.


Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”


Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.


The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**
------------------


Commure's RCM product grew up serving outpatient and ambulatory practices. We're now taking it into hospitals, and that's a different job: dozens of tax IDs, several EHRs, a revenue integrity team that tests you in week one, a CFO who wants a number by Friday. This role is the first hire on the Hospital Billing team, the function we're standing up this year to run those launches.


You'll own hospitals launches end to end, building the process while you're running it. Most roles at this level hand you a playbook. In this one you write it.


You won't do it alone. In addition to deep cross\-functional collaboration across Product, Eng, Operations, Sales, and Account Management teams you will work directly with the Hospital Billing GM to define and execute the critical business processes that are required to launch Commure’s largest and most complex customers. If you're coming from an implementation role elsewhere, the difference in scope is real: you keep the account and the number after go\-live.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own hospital launches end to end, from contract signature through stabilized production billing, as the named point of contact for the account
* Build the hospital launch playbook as you go: diligence playbooks, customer management workflows, detailed rule creation and configuration, and the automation needed to run it, none of which exists yet for hospital billing
* Work directly with a customer’s leadership and operations teams to translate enterprise complexity (multiple tax IDs, multiple EHRs, institutional adjudication rules) into smoothly executed implementation plans
* Coordinate daily with Commure's implementation, product, and payer enrollment teams so no account is carried solo
* Own the account after go\-live, driving stable and repeatable collections before transitioning the account to long term management
* Establish clear SLAs and a clean handoff process with the internal teams we partner with to power successful launches
* Help define what Launch and Account Management look like as separate functions within Hospital Billing as the team grows

**What You Have**
-----------------

* 6\+ years of experience in consulting, investment banking, or operations at a fast\-paced SaaS tech company
* A demonstrated history of creating opportunities for yourself and seeking ownership positions
* Comfortable working with data; proficiency in SQL and Excel. SQL or a robust analytical background (finance, consulting) is a plus
* Expertise in project management: you've deployed multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable building process without a playbook: you're not looking for a role where the steps are already written down
* Project confidence: you can run a meeting with a health system CFO or revenue integrity team and hold your own on a hard subject
* Confident with ambiguity: you're autonomous, you prioritize well, and you spot blockers before they become escalations
* Energized by people, relentless about finding the truth in a customer's ask rather than the easy answer
* Healthcare or RCM experience is a plus, not a filter.


Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

  

Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

Vaxcyte is a clinical\-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high\-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well\-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance.

**WHAT** we do is every bit as important as **HOW** we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values:

* RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re\-innovate the way vaccines are delivered.



* AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind.



* LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness\-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives.



* MODEL EXCELLENCE: The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making.
### **Summary:**



Vaxcyte is seeking a Commercial Project Manager to join the IT Project Management team and support commercial launch readiness. In partnership with the Commercial Launch Lead and cross\-functional stakeholders, this role will own key project management deliverables, including the integrated launch schedule, critical path, meeting governance, risk log, dashboards, status reporting, and communications. The role will also coordinate across Commercial and functional workstreams to support resource planning, KPI tracking, process and tool adoption, launch issue resolution, and post\-launch performance visibility.


### **Essential Functions:**


**Launch Readiness \& Timeline Accountability**


* Manages the integrated launch schedule, keeping timelines, milestones, dependencies, and decisions current and aligned.
* Manages the commercialization critical path, tracks priority milestones, and escalates timing or execution risks.
* Establishes meeting governance, including cadence, agendas, decisions, action items, and follow\-up.
* Administers the commercialization risk log, tracking risks, owners, mitigation plans, status, and escalations.


**Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Communication**


* Coordinates across Commercial and functional workstreams to maintain alignment, visibility, and timely information flow.
* Supports workstream owners by tracking deliverables, timelines, dependencies, and reviews without owning function\-specific content or decisions.
* Maintains dashboards, status reports, and communications that show readiness, risks, milestones, and dependencies.


**Resource Management**


* Supports capacity planning, demand management, and resource allocation.
* Identifies resource constraints and trade\-offs to support leadership decisions.


**Performance Metrics and Reporting**


* Develops and maintains selected project management KPIs.
* Uses performance trends to inform improvements and leadership discussions.


**Processes, Tools, and Dashboards**


* Maintains project management processes, tools, templates, and dashboards.
* Drives consistent use of standards and tools across projects.
* Improves visibility into project health, capacity, and outcomes.

### **Requirements:**


* MS, or BS degree in life sciences or biotechnology; advanced degree desired. Other combinations of education and/or experience may be considered.
* 8\+ years of project management experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or vaccines industry, with demonstrated skill managing cross\-functional timelines, dependencies, risks, governance, and communications.
* Experience supporting commercial launch readiness in pharma or vaccines, including coordination across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Market Access, Trade and Distribution, Supply, IT, and related functions.
* Experience enabling pharma commercial projects through digital tools, platforms, dashboards, and project management systems that improve visibility, coordination, and execution.
* Experience with direct sales or field commercial models, including non\-prescription or buy\-and\-bill channels; prescription\-only experience is not sufficient.
* Proven influence management and communication skills, at all levels of the organization
* Experience with Enterprise Planning (ERP) software for resource planning
* Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* PMP Certification and/or Project Management training desired
* All Vaxcyte employees require vaccination against COVID\-19

**Location:** Philadelphia, PA

**Work Arrangement (may be adjusted based on business needs, job responsibilities, or changes to company policy):**

jobs.title: Program Manager, Business Marketing
jobs.description:
Strategy \& Operations \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity.


The Business Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence by developing and executing strategies that drive awareness amongst core business audiences.


The Strategy \& Operations function supports Business Marketing with operating models and cadences; strategic planning; portfolio, resource, and investment management; measurement and organizational learning that empower our teams to move at pace with clarity and confidence.


**About the Role**


We’re looking for a resourcefuling marketing campaigns. You’ll manage our marketing portfolio and intake process, lead selected cross\-functional projects, and build AI\-enabled tools that make it easier for marketers to get their work done.


You’ll be the first partner for new requests: understanding the business need, sizing the work, and finding its best home. You’ll connect requests to existing campaigns and programs where possible, establish clear ownership, and make sure teams have the context and structure they need to move quickly.


This role combines an integrated marketing mindset with hands\-on project management and a builder’s instinct. You should enjoy being the person everyone reaches out to, making sense of ambiguity, and seeing how a small ask might become a much bigger thing—or when a big ask is actually something quite small. This role makes everyone’s life a little easier by providing a better understanding of what’s happening across the entire department, a clear way to kick off work with the right people, high\-touch support for our most intense projects, and useful systems that take friction out of everyone’s day.


**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------


* **Lead selected cross\-functional projects.** Build the model by program\-managing some of our biggest the process.
* **Run marketing intake and triage.** Clarify the audiences. Find a path to “yes, we can” for most requests, and feel comfortable telling a stakeholder “why not” if that’s truly the best answer.
* **Manage the ongoing marketing portfolio.** Maintain a clear view of active and upcoming work. Use your deep knowledge of the portfolio—including team members’ responsibilities and availability—to push for single\-threaded, named leadership when there are multiple contributors.
* **Find the right home for the work.** Determine whether a request belongs within an existing campaign, needs integrated marketing involvement, warrants a standalone project, or can be handled through self\-service. Understand that every request is important for some reason and treat it as such, while still making recommendations grounded in business priorities.
* **Set projects up for effective collaboration.** Create clarity by naming accountable ownersation structure. Use AI workflows to kick off briefs and project spaces and appropriately capture status updates and decision records.
* **Partner closely with Creative Operations.** Bring creative partners in early to help shape briefs and assess feasibility and production needs. Ensure Creative Operations has what it needs to assign creative staff, estimate capacity, scope agency agreements, and create production timelines.
* **Build and improve AI\-enabled tools and workflows.** Personally prototype and implement practical ways to improve intake, brief development, project setup, portfolio visibility, and reporting. Test with users, maintain appropriate human review, and improve what actually saves people time.
* **Make the operating model easier to use.** Use team feedback and delivery patterns to simplify processes, strengthen self\-service, and reduce repetitive coordination. Build systems that remain useful as the team and volume of work grow.

**You might thrive in this role, if you have:**
-----------------------------------------------


* 7\+ years of experience in marketing program and project management, integrated marketing management, or marketing portfolio management across multiple teams and concurrent priorities.
* A track record of personally leading cross\-functional projects, establishing ownership, managing dependencies, and driving work through to completion.
* An integrated marketing mindset: you see beyond an individual deliverable to understand its audience, purpose, campaign context, and relationship to other work.
* Strong judgment in ambiguous situationsation.
* Experience designing intake processes, project structures, and portfolio systems that people adopt and prefer to use because they make their lives easier.
* Hands\-on experience building AI\-enabled tools, automations, or workflows, with concrete examples of how they improved work. You can move from identifying a problem to testing and implementing a useful solution.
* The ability to build trust with marketers, creatives, and operational partners, including when you need to challenge an ask, reset expectations, or recommend a different path.
* A consulting\-like approach to problem\-solving: curiosity, structured thinking, comfort with unfamiliar problems, and a willingness to do hands\-on work.
* A bias toward simplicity and sustainable execution. You create clarity and momentum without adding meetings, processes, or maintenance that outweigh their value.

**About OpenAI**


OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.


We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager, Helen Diller Hospital
jobs.description:
The IT Project Manager, Helen Diller Hospital will lead planning, coordination, and execution of specific IT workstreams supporting the Helen Diller Hospital project, a multi\-year, large\-scale capital initiative. This role will manage the technology delivery through defined project framework processes and methodologies involving clinical applications, infrastructure, and end\-user systems to ensure alignment with hospital operational readiness and strategic goals. Responsibilities include managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, tasks, risks, deliverables, and dependencies across diverse stakeholder groups; facilitating decision\-making between IT, construction, and clinical leadership; and ensuring regulatory, security, and patient safety requirements are met. Monitors assigned project workstreams from initiation through completion. Organizes and leads activities relating to the management and completion of projects.


As an IT Project Manager for the Helen Diller Hospital project, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of healthcare delivery. This position is responsible for planning and implementing fully integrated IT solutions to support the new Helen Diller Hospital at Parnassus Heights. The work involves implementing IT services that are future\-ready, adaptable to emerging technologies, and capable of supporting smooth transitions over time.


This role requires an understanding of institutional, medical center, and systemwide priorities, as well as long\-term strategic goals. You will lead and manage complex IT workstreams with broad institutional impact, requiring sophisticated analysis, cross\-functional collaboration, and innovative problem\-solving.


The new 15\-story, 875,000 gross\-square\-foot (GSF) hospital will enable UCSF to provide much\-needed capacity for additional acute, emergency and intensive care beds, meet the state’s seismic requirements, and provide an optimal healing environment that addresses social, psychological, spiritual, and behavioral components of health in one place. The holistic focus on the needs of patients reflects UCSF’s integrated research, education and care delivery mission at Parnassus Heights. The new hospital will incorporate the latest innovations in technology and equipment for advanced complex care and bridge scientific research discoveries from bench to bedside leading to accelerated innovative treatments and therapies to benefit patients.


UCSF Health is a growing regional health system that includes UCSF Medical Center, the top\-ranked hospital in California and among the top five nationally, according to U.S. News \& World Report. The new hospital will be embedded within a campus that includes leading clinicians and scientists focused on translating discoveries into treatments and cures. UCSF Helen Diller Medical Center is part of a planned broader revitalization of the Parnassus Heights campus that also will modernize facilities supporting our research and education priorities.


As a member of the multi\-disciplinary UCSF Health IT team, you will be at the front line of creating the next generation of healthcare delivery. It involves a deep understanding of health care business capabilities, planned stakeholder experiences and journeys, technology, and proven project management methodologies.


To ensure a successful opening, the UCSF HDH IT Working Committee will define and prioritize opportunities to test new technologies and workflows that can be deployed earlier in existing hospitals. Through this continuous learning approach, you will help prepare our frontline staff and operations, and design for patients and families a seamless care experience between UCSF Health and partner care facilities, as well as pre\- and post\-procedure at home.  



**Department Overview**

UCSF Health IT is responsible for all aspects of clinical and business software applications, informatics, and AI for UCSF Health hospitals, practices, affiliates, and community partners. This includes the Electronic Health Record (APeX), which supports the clinical, revenue cycle, and clinical operational functions of the health system and its affiliates, and approximately 95 other software applications involved in patient care and operations.


The HDH Sr. IT Project Manager must be able to adhere to and emulate the Health IT culture and core values as stated below:


“People First: Patients are healthier and families happier with clinical systems to support them. Our solutions enable providers and staff to pioneer care, train the next generation of clinical leaders, and secure UCSF’s future. We use talent, creativity, and diverse skillsets to tackle tough problems. We strive to be proactive, and make time to innovate, appreciate and connect. When something big is needed, we deliver.  



**Health IT Core Values include:**

**Judgment:** Makes wise decisions, identifies root causes, thinks strategically, and prioritizes what to do now and what can be improved later.  



**Communication:** Listens well, is concise and articulate in speech and writing, treats people with respect independent of their status, and maintains calm poise in stressful situations.  



**Impact:** Accomplishes amazing amounts of important work, colleagues can rely upon you, focuses on results,


exhibits bias\-to\-action, and avoids analysis\-paralysis  



**Innovation:** Finds practical solutions to hard problems, suggests better approaches and new ideas that prove useful, and stays nimble by minimizing complexity and finding time to simplify.  



**Collaboration:** Understands that work cannot be accomplished solely as an individual contributor; works through others to develop holistic solutions that meet our customer needs and the goals of the organization.


  
**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field and/or equivalen

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Client Delivery
jobs.description:
**Vivodyne creates human data before clinical trials.**
-------------------------------------------------------



We accelerate the successful discovery, design, and development of human therapeutics by testing on large, lab\-grown human organ tissues at massive scale, driving technological advancement at the convergence of novel biology, robotics, and AI. We identify and validate new therapeutic targets and de\-risk new therapeutic assets by producing clinically translatable multi\-omic data from our proprietary, physiologically\-realistic human organ tissues at unprecedented scale, speed, and quality. This enables us to produce more human data than all clinical trials in the U.S. combined. We’re financially backed by some of the most selective and successful venture funds, and we have already partnered with a majority of the top 10 multinational pharmaceutical companies to discover and develop better, safer drugs and dramatically reduce the burden of animal testing.



www.vivodyne.com


**Role**
--------



Vivodyne is seeking a **Senior Program Manager, Client Delivery** to lead the operational delivery of complex client programs across Vivodyne’s scientific, technical, and commercial teams. This person will serve as a primary internal coordinator and, for assigned accounts, a client\-facing program lead. They will translate work plans into executable schedules, maintain clear communication, surface risks early, and ensure delivery commitments remain visible across teams.



This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in San Francisco, working closely with a bicoastal delivery team, with occasional travel to our Philadelphia site.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


#### **Client Engagement \& Delivery**


* **Own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of complex client programs**, accountable for delivering against agreed scope, timelines, budget, and client commitments from kickoff and work\-plan alignment through execution, data delivery, closeout, and subsequent phases. Programs may span multiple technical workstreams, sites, external partners, and extended timelines.
* **Act as a consistent client\-facing program lead** for assigned accounts, establishing communication cadence, coordinating key decisions and follow\-ups, providing clear status updates, and raising schedule or deliverable risks early.
* **Lead client kickoff and delivery planning**, ensuring work plans, dependencies, ownership, collaboration workflows, and legal or operational prerequisites are aligned before execution.
* **Coordinate data and documentation delivery**, establishing clear expectations, ownership, and timelines for technical reports, assay and methods documentation, data packages, presentations, and client communications.

#### **Internal Stakeholder Alignment \& Resource Management**


* **Build and maintain integrated program plans** covering milestones, dependencies, study schedules, resources, owners, risks, and delivery dates, providing practical execution guidance when programs compete for shared resources.
* **Coordinate cross\-functional execution** across biology, operations, microfabrication, hardware/software, data analysis, business development, and leadership. Translate program objectives and requirements into clear internal context, decisions, and next steps.
* **Manage scope, capacity, and schedule trade\-offs**, identifying constraints across resource availability, product readiness, staffing, materials, technical development, client requirements, and operational capacity; facilitate decisions and communicate their implications.
* **Run portfolio\-level delivery operating rhythms**, including weekly reviews and leadership updates that surface priorities, risks, decisions, and cross\-team dependencies.
* **Maintain a reliable system for program and portfolio management**, ensuring project plans, ownership, dependencies, risks, and status remain current and visible across teams.

#### **Strategy \& Operational Excellence**


* **Coordinate internal R\&D and tissue roadmap execution** in partnership with biology and product leads, translating scientific priorities into executable plans, milestones, and timelines. Balance internal model and capability development with client delivery commitments.
* **Partner with BD and leadership on feasibility, resourcing, pricing, and delivery planning** for prospective and expanding client work, helping evaluate scope alternatives, timelines, cost inputs, and operational feasibility.
* **Improve delivery processes and knowledge transfer** by documenting repeatable workflows, clarifying ownership, creating training materials, and ensuring critical program and account knowledge is transferable across the team.
* **Lead and champion program management best practices**, creating consistent ways of working across teams for planning, execution, risk management, communication, and delivery

### **What success looks like**


* Client programs are delivered against agreed scope, timelines, budget, and client commitments, with deviations proactively managed and communicated.
* Clients have a clear, reliable view of milestones, deliverables, owners, and changes.
* Internal teams understand the scientific and commercial context of their work.
* Risks and dependency conflicts are identified and addressed early, with explicit options and decisions.
* Program plans reflect reliable data and actual operational capacity rather than only desired timelines.
* Data, methods, and client\-facing materials are delivered in an organized, predictable way.
* Program knowledge is well\-documented for clean account ownership transfers.
* Client delivery and internal R\&D priorities are effectively balanced and coordinated.

**Requirements and Expectations**
---------------------------------


* 5\+ years of experience leading complex, cross\-functional programs in biotech, pharma, life sciences, CRO/CDMO, healthcare technology, or a similarly technical client\-delivery

jobs.title: Data Center Program Manager
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services is seeking a detail oriented, customer obsessed Program Manager for its Infrastructure Operations team.
  

  

Our Program Managers are able to quickly adapt strategies, plans and solutions in response to dynamic business requirements. They also must be comfortable interfacing and driving various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organization. If you have previous project engineering experience, are ready to take on challenges, open minded, appreciate team comradely, have an occasional sense of humor and want to help Amazon raise the bar, then this role is for you!  

  

Successful candidates are natural self\-starters who possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges while driving these solutions to completion. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi\-disciplinary teams (internal operations, engineering, legal, finance, procurement, environmental/health/safety, etc.). This individual has strong communication skills, is organized and thrive in ambiguity.
  

  

The scope of role encompasses program management of capital expense (CAPEX) and/or operational expense (OPEX) projects within data center operations. The scope of projects will include but not be limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection, building improvements, vendor (partner) management, and cluster wide maintenance coordination. An understanding of these systems is necessary, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other teams and organizations.  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Manage requirements, budget, design, and implementation of assigned projects  

  

Assess annual maintenance program requirements and build a rolling 18 month project forecast  

  

Facilitate creation of SOWs with partner teams to be included in contract documents including RFQ/RFPs, change order controls, purchase orders, and invoicing.  

  

Evaluate performance and work product of on\-site partners and escalate issues through Amazon leadership.  

  

Identify and communicate needs for design improvements.  

  

Monitor and enforce project schedules and quality with, operational teams, cross functional amazon team members, and partners.  

  

Lead and coordinate design and execution efforts between internal teams and outside partners including equipment specifications, material flow, process design, and site layout.  

  

Evaluate project risks and issues and propose actionable resolutions.  

  

Build strong working relationships with data center leadership teams across multiple sites as well as other internal stakeholders (operations, finance, safety, security, legal, procurement).  

  

General knowledge of data center operations and facility management.  

  

Track record for being detail\-oriented with a demonstrated ability to self\-motivate and follow\-through on projects  

  

Ability to follow accurate and complete support procedures, system documentation, and issue tracking entries.  

  

Proactively and continually improve your level of knowledge about data center relevant technologies.
  

  

About the team  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

jobs.title: Senior Channel Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end\-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.



We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.


Posting Open Date: 8/18/2026



Anticipated Posting Close Date\*: 10/30/2026


* *Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.*

  


**Senior Channel Enablement Manager**



As a Senior Channel Enablement Manager at Fastly, you will drive the strategy and delivery that arms our global partner ecosystem and Channel Account Managers with the ultimate competitive edge. You’ll serve as one of the primary architects behind our channel success, creating high\-impact enablement content, delivering engaging virtual sessions, and seamlessly executing end\-to\-end enablement program logistics. Embedded within a highly collaborative team, you will partner closely with Channel Marketing, Operations, and Program Management to build a cohesive growth engine. Your work directly accelerates Fastly’s market reach and revenue by turning complex technology into actionable selling strategies for our partners. By empowering the people who power our platform's growth, you will play a pivotal role in scaling our footprint and defining the future of the edge.


**What You'll Do:**


* *Manage the Partner Enablement Program*
* *Create relevant content and manage the curriculum*
* *Execute on strategic initiatives with Channel Marketing, Operations and Program Management*
* *Facilitate internal and external training sessions*
* *Manage metrics to ensure program success*

**What We're Looking For:**


* *Channel \& Partner Enablement Expertise:* *5\+ years of experience in channel enablement, partner training, or sales enablement within enterprise SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or cybersecurity environments*
* *Content Creation \& Instructional Design:* *Proven track record of developing engaging, high\-impact learning assets—such as battle cards, pitch decks, quick\-reference guides, and interactive e\-learning modules.*
* *LMS \& Tool Proficiency:* *Hands\-on experience administering Partner Relationship Management (PRM) systems, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and virtual facilitation tools (e.g., Zoom, Salesforce, WorkRamp, Highspot).*
* *Virtual Facilitation \& Presentation:* *Exceptional public speaking and presentation skills with demonstrated experience leading interactive, large\-scale virtual workshops and training sessions for external teams.*
* *Cross\-Functional Alignment:* *Strong project management abilities to align cross\-functional initiatives across Channel Sales, Channel Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Product Marketing.*
* *Metrics \& Analytics Focus:* *Proficiency in tracking and measuring enablement effectiveness (e.g., partner certification rates, deal registration volume, time\-to\-first\-deal) to continuously optimize programs.*

**We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:**


* *Partner Ecosystem Mastery:* *Deep understanding of partner GTM models, including Value\-Added Resellers (VARs), Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Global System Integrators (GSIs), and referral programs.*
* *Technical Aptitude:* *Ability to translate complex cloud technologies (e.g., edge cloud computing, CDN, API security, and serverless architectures) into clear, value\-driven sales messaging for non\-technical channel reps.*

**Work Hours:**


* This position will require you to be available during core business hours.

**Work Location(s) \& Travel Requirements:**



This position is open to Hybrid And Fully Remote Work Locations.



The preferred locations for those who are hybrid include:


* San Francisco

Technical Account Manager

BAY AREA · NORTHERN CALIFORNIA FULL\-TIME BASE \+ MILESTONE BONUSES \+ UNCAPPED COMMISSION

01\. ABOUT US

Trilion Quality Systems is a precision metrology and NDE company based in King of Prussia, PA, and the US representative for ZEISS IQS optical testing systems. Our sister company, Xi Analytics, develops real\-time optical metrology and AI\-based measurement technology for advanced material testing and aerospace structural applications.

As the exclusive ZEISS Certified Metrology Partner in North America, Trilion’s experienced team of thirty people has spent the last 30 years doing one thing: connecting physical measurement with certified digital insight. More than 90% of the top ten US aerospace, automotive, biomechanics, and electronics companies work with us as their ZEISS DIC partner. This means that you will spend most weeks on innovative projects at Fortune 100 aerospace, defense, automotive, and consumer electronics companies, on test articles that are usually confidential, and you will be the person they call first. We’re an agile team and you won’t waste months waiting on committees and layers of management.

02\. ABOUT THE ROLE

Trilion is opening a Bay Area office around San Mateo in 2026 and hiring a Technical Account Manager to carry Northern California. This is a quota\-carrying, field\-based role, and you will be the primary technical and commercial contact for customers in the territory from the first conversation through demonstration, proposal, purchase order, and long\-term account growth.

You will spend most of your week in front of engineers in their test labs, not behind a desk. Optical metrology is sold by showing it, so much of the job is setting up a system on a customer's test article and letting the data make the argument. Strain gauges read a handful of points and miss the concentrations and asymmetries that decide whether a design passes certification. Full\-field DIC makes every pixel a measurement point, in 3D, NIST\-traceable, and ready for FEA correlation in minutes.

You will not be just a coordinator who forwards technical questions. Once ramped, you are expected to be able to run standard demonstrations and beginner trainings yourself, with our expert engineering team behind you for complex projects, dedicated multi\-day training, and on\-site service work. The technical credibility that comes with it is how you sell on results and direct knowledge rather than on a brochure.

You will not be working a blank list. Leads reach you through ZEISS and through Trilion’s own marketing, and you will generate the rest yourself at proven trade shows, through customer referrals, and by developing accounts we already serve. Revenue splits close to evenly three ways: new accounts, new teams inside existing accounts, and recurring business from our customer base. This means that a majority of projects will come from customers who already know and trust us, which is why account management matters here as much as new business. The ramp is deliberate: expect full autonomy over the territory within 6 to 8 months, backed by milestone bonuses while the funnel builds. Your first three months will follow a structured onboarding plan with active coaching, defined milestones and hands\-on time alongside our engineers, so you are not left to work it out on your own. Capital equipment cycles are long, but we don’t starve a good engineer waiting for the first sale to close.

03\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory and accounts

* Own the Bay Area and Northern California territory across aerospace, microelectronics and consumer electronics, space and defense, automotive and EV, medical device, and industrial and civil structures
* Work inbound leads from ZEISS and our digital marketing through qualification to first meeting
* Generate the rest of your pipeline yourself: trade show and conference follow\-up, referrals, and prospecting into new groups inside accounts we already serve
* Support existing accounts and identify follow\-on system, software, and service opportunities
* Forecast territory opportunities accurately and keep management updated on a regular cadence

Technical selling and delivery

* Present and demonstrate ARAMIS, ATOS, TRITOP, and the wider ZEISS portfolio at customer test labs and trade shows
* Run standard demonstrations and basic software training independently once ramped, including specimen preparation and system setup
* Process and present measurement results, and run proof\-of\-concept engagements and ROI analyses tied to the customer's test program
* Bring in our engineering team for complex projects, multi\-day training, and service work

Deal execution

* Design and develop tailored proposals and system configurations
* Manage the full sales process from first contact through purchase order
* Maintain accurate account, contact, and opportunity records in HubSpot CRM and Odoo ERP

04\. ABOUT YOU

* 2 to 3 years of experience in technical sales, applications engineering, or hands\-on test and measurement work, in aerospace \& defense, electronics \& AR/VR hardware, automotive \& EV, robotics, biomechanics, material science or an adjacent field
* MS/BS in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Material Science or similar Engineering Major
* Comfortable with mechanical engineering fundamentals: strain, stress, fatigue, and structural test
* Comfortable explaining technical concepts clearly and concisely to test engineers and executives
* Hands\-on experience with test equipment or measurement instrumentation, and the confidence to run a live system demonstration in front of a customer without support
* Willing and able to generate your own pipeline: outbound calls and emails, trade show and conference follow\-up, and prospecting into adjacent groups at existing accounts
* Organized and self\-directed; this territory runs on a plan you build yourself
* Excellent computer skills including AI usage for day\-to\-day sales engineerin

Vynca is looking for a detail\-oriented and organized People Operations Coordinator to support the day\-to\-day operations of our HR and Talent teams. jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Specialist I *PC 604
jobs.description:
Your Role:


This position provides quality assurance oversight for cGMP manufacturing of advanced cell and gene therapy products. Ensures strict compliance with FDA, EMA, ISO and other applicable regulations through real\-time shop\-floor support, batch record review, and disposition of raw materials and final drug products. This position also supports the implementation of the quality systems in compliance with cGMPs and other company policies.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


* Perform review of batch records for intermediate or final product, cell banks including in\-process testing, QC release testing data packages, labeling, packaging, and all supporting documentation
* Inspect, review, and disposition raw materials, reagents and components
* Facilitate investigations relating to manufactured products and raw materials
* Provide QA oversight and QA on the floor support during GMP manufacturing operations
* Conduct line clearances, in\-process inspections, support final product packaging operations, etc.
* Assist cross\-functional teams with the initiation, investigation, and approval of Change Controls, Deviations, and CAPAs, providing critical QA input throughout.
* Create, review and revise standard operating procedures, study protocols, reports, and other GxP documents as needed.
* Coordinate the release of final cell\-based therapeutic products for clinical and commercial applications.
* Participate in audit of internal departments, external clients, suppliers, and service providers and completion of audit reports as needed.
* Review and approve validation and qualification packages including installation, operation, and performance qualifications (IQ, OQ, PQ) protocols and reports as necessary.
* Train and provide QA guidance to internal functional groups on Quality Systems.
* Provide environmental monitoring support as needed.
* Participate in internal and client facing meetings as needed.
* 8:00am to 5:00pm with irregular hours/weekends/nights.
* Other duties as assigned


Requirements:


* Bachelor’s degree in life science; 5\+ years of direct QA experience related to GMP Manufacturing in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience in cell\-based therapeutics or biopharmaceuticals preferred.
* Experience working with Quality Systems, writing deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls.
* Experience in supporting/assisting the internal and external audits, inspections.


 Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:


* Strong knowledge of cGMPs and FDA, EMA, ICH, and ISO regulatory requirements.
* Knowledge of Quality Systems, including Deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls, document control, and training processes.
* Knowledge of batch record review, Good Documentation Practices (GDP), and product release activities.
* Knowledge of validation and qualification activities, including IQ/OQ/PQ.
* Strong investigation, problem\-solving, and risk assessment skills.
* Strong technical writing, document review, and communication skills.
* Ability to provide QA oversight in a GMP manufacturing environment.
* Ability to support audits, inspections, and regulatory readiness activities.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and provide QA guidance.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to make compliant quality decisions.


Physical Demands:



The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms, talk, and hear. The employee is required to stand; climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Must have ability to handle more than one task at a time and must work at a rapid pace while maintaining attention to detail.



Work Environment:



This job is performed in a temperature\-controlled facility without exposure to extreme hot or cold temperatures. Generally, this job is performed in a cleanroom setting and routinely uses standard medical and research equipment such as centrifuges, biosafety cabinets, microscopes, incubators, chromatography devices and columns, tangential\-flow filtration devices and filters, peristaltic pumps and metering fill pumps, pipettes and computers. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to blood, viruses, bacteria, body fluids and other tissues. Employees entering and leaving the laboratory must wear appropriate clothing and protective equipment such as lab coats, glasses and gloves. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

jobs.description:
Client Services Representative


**Eco Performance Builders** is a well\-established and rapidly growing licensed general, HVAC, and insulation contractor dedicated to enhancing homes for optimal efficiency, comfort, and sustainability. With 14 years of industry experience, we take pride in making existing homes more energy\-efficient and comfortable.

  

We’re looking for an organized, proactive, and personable **Client Services Representative** to become a key part of our client experience and day\-to\-day operations.

  

This is first and foremost a **client service position**. You will often be the first person a prospective or existing client speaks with, so excellent communication, listening skills, professionalism, and attention to detail are essential. The right person will also be self\-directed, comfortable with technology, eager to learn, and interested in understanding the technical aspects of the work we do.

  

Key Responsibilities



Client Service \& Phone Communication


* Serve as the primary person answering our phones and one of the first points of contact for prospective and existing clients. You’ll listen carefully to understand prospective clients' needs, educate them about our services, answer initial questions, and help determine whether our company is a good fit for their project.
* This position involves both **incoming and outbound calls**, so you should enjoy speaking with people and be comfortable initiating conversations. Excellent phone etiquette, a friendly and professional speaking voice, strong listening skills, and attention to detail are important.


Scheduling \& Follow\-Up


* Schedule **sales visits and home walkthroughs** for prospective clients and help coordinate other appointments as needed.
* Follow up with clients at the completion of their projects to ensure they are satisfied and identify any outstanding items that need to be communicated to the appropriate team member.


Software, Systems \& Process Improvement


* You should be **tech\-savvy and eager to learn new software** as our company relies on a variety of software and digital tools to manage clients, projects, scheduling, and communication.
* We also value people who proactively identify opportunities to improve our systems and processes. If you see a way to better organize information, simplify a workflow, or improve how the company operates, we want you to speak up and help make it happen.


Special Projects \& Team Support


* From time to time, you may be asked to assist with projects outside of your normal day\-to\-day responsibilities. This could include supporting our sales and management teams with **larger RFP and bid submissions**, gathering and organizing documentation, preparing information, performing research, scheduling service and maintenance calls, project management, or helping with other company initiatives.
* You should be comfortable learning new tasks, taking ownership of assignments, and working independently when given a goal.


Learning Our Business


* We work in a technical industry involving **building science, home performance, HVAC, electrification, insulation, energy efficiency, and indoor air quality**.
* You don't need to arrive as a technical expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn. Over time, we expect you to develop enough understanding of our services to communicate effectively with clients and our technical staff.


Representing the Company


* You should be comfortable speaking with new people, communicating professionally over Zoom, and representing Eco Performance Builders at trade shows, job fairs, community events, and other public\-facing opportunities.


The Person We’re Looking For



The right person for this position is:


* **Organized and detail\-oriented** – You keep track of schedules, conversations, documentation, and follow\-ups without letting details fall through the cracks.
* **A strong communicator and listener** – You have excellent phone etiquette, a professional speaking voice, and communicate clearly and thoughtfully.
* **Proactive and self\-directed** – You don't need someone continually telling you what to do next. You can prioritize your work, stay productive, identify things that need attention, and work independently.
* **Tech\-savvy and eager to learn** – You're comfortable learning new software and interested in finding better ways to use technology and improve company processes.
* **Easygoing and patient** – You work well alongside different personalities and can remain professional and productive during stressful or challenging situations. You don't take personality differences or workplace frustrations personally and focus instead on working together to get the job done.
* **Punctual and dependable** – Your coworkers and our clients can count on you to show up on time and follow through on commitments.
* **A team player** – You're willing to pitch in, communicate openly, and help wherever needed.
* **Solution\-oriented and blame\-free** – When something goes wrong, you focus on solving the problem, learning from it, and moving forward rather than assigning blame or creating unnecessary drama.
* **Flexible** – You're comfortable adjusting when priorities, schedules, or circumstances change.
* **Curious and willing to learn** – You're interested in developing an understanding of building science and the technical aspects of our work.


What Success Looks Like


* A successful Client Services Representative is someone **our clients and our team can depend on**. Calls and follow\-ups happen when promised, sales visits are scheduled accurately, warranties are registered, information reaches the right people, and details don't get lost.
* Just as importantly, you take ownership of your role, continue learning, contribute to a positive and productive workplace, and look for opportunities to help the company operate more effectively.

The Position
  
  

Clinical Study Program Manager \- Santa Clara, CA
  
A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

The Clinical Study Program Manager will direct multiple moderate to complex exploratory research and clinical projects from study initiation through contract completion in our Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) division. jobs.title: Clinical Program Manager
jobs.description:
We’re here for one reason and one reason only – to cure cancer. Every moment is dedicated to developing treatments and every action moves us one step closer to our goal. We’ve made incredible scientific breakthroughs and our pioneering personalized CAR T\-cell therapies have changed the paradigm. But we're not finished yet.


Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next.


We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Kite and help create more tomorrows.  



**Job Description**
-------------------

Job Description
Clinical Operations is responsible for the worldwide execution of all Phase I \- IV clinical trials across all Gilead therapeutic areas. Clinical Operations plays a key role in ensuring all Gilead clinical trials are performed in accordance with applicable SOPs, company policies and regulatory guidelines to provide timely and high\-quality clinical data that supports global registration and commercialization of Gilead’s products.


You will manage a team of direct and potentially indirect reports. You will oversee and be responsible for the successful execution of studies and/or multiple studies within a program or multiple programs, including financial responsibility. You will be responsible for the resource management of studies, including ongoing assessment of resource needs and optimal deployment of resources to support a fluid ‘One Ops’ workforce. jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager, Implementation & Accounts - Hospital Billing
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.


Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”


Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.


The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.


**About the Role**
------------------


Commure's RCM product grew up serving outpatient and ambulatory practices. We're now taking it into hospitals, and that's a different job: dozens of tax IDs, several EHRs, a revenue integrity team that tests you in week one, a CFO who wants a number by Friday. This role is the first hire on the Hospital Billing team, the function we're standing up this year to run those launches.


You'll own hospitals launches end to end, building the process while you're running it. Most roles at this level hand you a playbook. In this one you write it.


You won't do it alone. In addition to deep cross\-functional collaboration across Product, Eng, Operations, Sales, and Account Management teams you will work directly with the Hospital Billing GM to define and execute the critical business processes that are required to launch Commure’s largest and most complex customers. If you're coming from an implementation role elsewhere, the difference in scope is real: you keep the account and the number after go\-live.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Own hospital launches end to end, from contract signature through stabilized production billing, as the named point of contact for the account
* Build the hospital launch playbook as you go: diligence playbooks, customer management workflows, detailed rule creation and configuration, and the automation needed to run it, none of which exists yet for hospital billing
* Work directly with a customer’s leadership and operations teams to translate enterprise complexity (multiple tax IDs, multiple EHRs, institutional adjudication rules) into smoothly executed implementation plans
* Coordinate daily with Commure's implementation, product, and payer enrollment teams so no account is carried solo
* Own the account after go\-live, driving stable and repeatable collections before transitioning the account to long term management
* Establish clear SLAs and a clean handoff process with the internal teams we partner with to power successful launches
* Help define what Launch and Account Management look like as separate functions within Hospital Billing as the team grows

**What You Have**
-----------------


* 6\+ years of experience in consulting, investment banking, or operations at a fast\-paced SaaS tech company
* A demonstrated history of creating opportunities for yourself and seeking ownership positions
* Comfortable working with data; proficiency in SQL and Excel. SQL or a robust analytical background (finance, consulting) is a plus
* Expertise in project management: you've deployed multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable building process without a playbook: you're not looking for a role where the steps are already written down
* Project confidence: you can run a meeting with a health system CFO or revenue integrity team and hold your own on a hard subject
* Confident with ambiguity: you're autonomous, you prioritize well, and you spot blockers before they become escalations
* Energized by people, relentless about finding the truth in a customer's ask rather than the easy answer
* Healthcare or RCM experience is a plus, not a filter.

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.
