Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

jobs.title: Senior HR Generalist
jobs.description:
At **d\-Matrix**, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of **respect and collaboration.**


We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our **team is inclusive**, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution. Ready to come find your playground? **Together**, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI.

 **Role Overview**


d\-Matrix is looking for a Senior HR Generalist with deep compensation and data expertise to help us make sound, defensible pay decisions in a highly competitive market for AI and technical talent. This is an individual contributor role that will own the analytical backbone of our compensation and people data — market benchmarking, salary structures, internal equity, and merit/bonus modeling — while also supporting broader People Operations. This is a hands\-on generalist role rather than a pure Total Rewards specialist position: you'll bring real analytical depth to compensation and reporting and flex into core HR ops work as needed, with complex executive and sales compensation design handled by specialized outside expertise. You'll partner closely with HRBPs, Business Leaders, Talent Acquisition, Global Mobility and Immigration, Employee Relations, and Legal to deliver efficient, data\-informed HR service.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead market benchmarking and survey data analysis to keep salary ranges and job structures competitive and defensible.
* Own job matching and leveling, ensuring consistency and internal equity across the organization.
* Build and maintain compensation models for merit cycles, bonus pools, and promotions, translating data into clear, sound recommendations.
* Support offer construction and internal equity analysis for new hires, promotions, and internal moves, including equity compensation.
* Build and maintain HR reporting and dashboards (e.g., headcount, comp analytics, turnover), using HR data to identify trends, risks, and process gaps.
* Own core People Operations processes — onboarding, offboarding, employee records, HR documentation, payroll coordination, and benefits administration.
* Serve as HR systems owner (ADP WFN, Ashby, Lattice), ensuring data accuracy and integrity, and supporting integrations, audits, and troubleshooting.
* Partner cross\-functionally on HR service delivery, and maintain HR policies, procedures, and SOPs in response to regulatory changes.

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years in HR Operations, with meaningful, hands\-on compensation experience — not limited to participating in an annual comp cycle.
* Direct experience with market benchmarking/survey data, salary structure design, job matching/leveling, internal equity analysis, and merit/bonus modeling.
* Solid understanding of equity compensation.
* Strong Excel and analytical skills, with the ability to build models rather than just interpret them.
* Experience with HRIS/ATS systems (e.g., ADP WFN, Ashby) supporting data\-driven people operations.

**Equal Opportunity Employment Policy**

**d\-Matrix** is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day.

**d\-Matrix** does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individual interested in opportunities with d\-Matrix apply directly through our official channels. jobs.description:
**WHAT IS BOX?**



Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.



By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

  


**WHY BOX NEEDS YOU**



The mission of the Global Go to Market (GTM) Enablement team is to empower Box's customer\-facing teams with the knowledge, skills, and tools they need to win. As our **Sales Productivity Manager**, you will sit at the intersection of business strategy, data\-driven skill diagnostics, and modern learning design.



In this role, you will translate strategic company priorities into practical, high\-impact enablement programs for Box Account Executives. Leveraging seller performance data, CRM analytics, and cross\-functional partnerships across Sales, Enablement, and Operations, you will build and execute skills\-based curricula, world\-class onboarding paths, and interactive practice labs. By integrating AI\-first tools and establishing rigorous performance benchmarks, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating ramp time, increasing quota attainment, and driving sustained sales excellence across our global teams.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* **Seller Productivity curriculum design:** Design and deliver role\-specific, skills\-based curriculum for AEs focused on core selling competencies: discovery, qualification, demo delivery, value\-based selling, objection handling, negotiation, and account planning. Design and deliver AE onboarding.
* **Lead live training and coaching:** Facilitate and deliver instructor\-led workshops, virtual skill labs, bootcamps, and reinforcement sessions that emphasize practice, feedback, and behavior change. Design and administer skill assessments and proficiency checks to measure competency and guide coaching.
* **Generate consensus:** Build consensus and momentum across senior, cross\-functional audiences including field leadership and sales operations to diagnose skill gaps using performance metrics, CRM data, call recordings, and seller feedback; prioritize high\-impact skills.
* **Program element creation:** Create short\-form learning assets to support your curriculum: recorded coaching, video role\-plays, microlearning modules, practice scenarios, assessments, and facilitator guides.
* **Program management:** Establish and maintain a training cadence (onboarding, ramp, role progression support, ongoing practice cycles) and ensure consistent delivery across regions and teams managing to timelines, functional priorities, and project plans.
* **Measure:** Define KPIs for training initiatives (ramp time, skill proficiency, call\-to\-demo conversion, win rates where applicable) and iterate curriculum based on data.
* **AI\-First enablement:** Leverage Box AI and modern generative AI tools to 10X the onboarding and sales skills building experience

  

  

**WHO YOU ARE**


* 4\+ years in sales enablement, sales training, or related roles in B2B SaaS with direct experience training quota\-carrying sellers.
* Instructional design instincts: demonstrated success designing and delivering skills\-focused learning that improved seller behaviors and measurable performance outcomes.
* Strong facilitation and coaching skills: comfortable leading live sessions and conducting role\-play–based skills practice.
* Knowledge of sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC/MEDDIC, SPIN, Challenger, Command of the Message) and ability to translate methodology into practical seller behaviors.
* Experience using coaching tools and sources of truth for skills diagnostics: call recording platforms, LMS, CRM (Salesforce preferred), and enablement analytics.
* Project and stakeholder management experience; ability to coordinate across a matrixed organization and multiple regions.
* Proven ability to work at AI\-speed, in fast\-paced, matrixed environments
* Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

  



Preferred skills


* Experience enabling both new business and expansion/renewal sellers.
* Background in adult learning, instructional design, or certification in relevant fields (ATD, CPLP).
* Experience running sales role\-play programs, certification paths, or coach\-the\-coach initiatives.
* Facilitation, curriculum design for skills practice, behavioral assessment, and data\-driven iteration.

  

  

Success metrics (first 6–12 months)


* Shorter ramp time for new sellers (baseline set in first 30 days).
* Improved proficiency scores on prioritized skills.
* Increased conversion metrics tied to trained skills (e.g., demo\-to\-opportunity).
* High adoption and satisfaction from sellers and managers.

  



Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
We are looking for **two** Business Analysts to join our team!

**About Perfected**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------


When corporations cause harm, someone has to answer for it. At Perfected, we guide people through complex legal journeys with one clear goal: to hold corporations accountable and help communities reclaim their power.


We start with people—their stories, their pain, their hope—and we stand with them every step of the way. Our work is rooted in transparency, empathy, and advocacy. We partner with law firms across the country to bring clarity to chaos, amplify community voices, and create human\-centered experiences that make justice feel within reach.

**Location Note**


These are remote\-based positions and all work must be performed in a state in which Strategic Campaign Sourcing LLC is registered to do business (AL, CA, CO, FL, GA, HI, IL, KY, LA, MA, ME, MI, NV, NJ, NY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VI, VA, WI). Our preference is for applicants located \- or willing and able to work \- in the Pacific or Mountain time zones.

 **About the Role**


The **Business Analyst** will support the operational efficiency, data quality, and reporting needs of our Client Operations and Business Operations teams. This role is ideal for someone who is detail\-oriented, highly organized, and eager to build a strong foundation in operations, analytics, and process improvement.


As a Business Analyst, you’ll play a critical role in maintaining daily operational reporting, supporting data ingestion and quality control, tracking production and capacity metrics, and assisting with process documentation. You’ll work closely with Senior Program Leads, Program Leads, and cross\-functional partners to ensure teams have accurate data, clear processes, and reliable insights to support decision\-making.


This role provides hands\-on exposure to operational workflows, reporting systems, and continuous improvement initiatives, with a clear growth path into Program Lead and Senior Program Lead roles over time.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Prepare and distribute daily, weekly, and ad hoc operational reports for internal stakeholders.
* Support regular data uploads and track successful ingestion into key systems.
* Perform quality control (QC) checks on operational data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Identify data discrepancies and escalate issues for resolution.
* Maintain and update production tracking tools and capacity planning trackers.
* Support workload analysis and resource utilization reporting.
* Assist in identifying trends or potential risks related to volume, capacity, or throughput.
* Compile, maintain, and manage client communication distribution lists to support accurate outreach.
* Ensure lists and datasets are up to date and aligned with current operational requirements.
* Support coordination across teams by providing timely and accurate data inputs.
* Assist in drafting, updating, and maintaining SOPs, process documentation, and reference materials.
* Contribute to process standardization efforts across programs.
* Support implementation of updated workflows by ensuring documentation remains current
* Assist in building dashboards and operational insights to support leadership decision\-making.
* Collaborate with Program Leads and Senior Program Leads on improvement initiatives.
* Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and performance development conversations.
* Take on additional analytical or operational support tasks as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required.
* 1\+ years of experience in operations, reporting, data support, or administrative roles.
* Experience in legal, healthcare, or client services environments is a plus.
* Familiarity with reporting systems, CRMs, or project management tools is helpful but not required.
* Comfort working with large datasets and repetitive tasks while maintaining accuracy.
* Proficiency in Excel (PivotTables, VLOOKUPs, formulas).

**Skills \& Abilities**
-----------------------

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
* Willingness to learn, ask questions, and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.
* Adaptability in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

* Frequent need for oral, written, and auditory communication.
* Ability to sit for long periods of time.
* Prolonged periods working on a computer.
* Frequent repetitive hand and wrist motions.
* Excellent near vision to see details on a computer screen, including color differentiation.
* Ability to work in a fast paced and sometimes stressful services environment.
* Occasional need for travel.

**Benefits at a Glance**
------------------------

* **Time Off:** PTO (15 days, earned on an accrual basis; increases at 3rd and 5th anniversary), sick leave (10 days, earned on an accrual basis), paid holidays (14\) and floating holidays (2 days).
* **Health \& Wellness:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

Stevenson is a mission driven school that aims to help students shape joyful lives while instilling a passion for learning and achievement to prepare them for success in school and beyond.

This position reports to our *Director of Data Operations* and will oversee the technical platforms, workflows, and data structures that power clear, accurate, and timely communications across the school community. Operating within the Office of the Chief Information Officer, this role serves as the primary technical operator for Slate, Stevenson’s internal information system, translating communication needs into dynamic digital workflows, managing audience segmentation, and building repeatable systems for recurring and event\-based communications. This position is remote, with occasional travel to the School’s Pebble Beach and Carmel campuses (3 to 4 visits per year).

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, test, schedule, and distribute mass communications, dynamic forms, and event portals in Slate.

**The Role**

We're looking for an Ad Operations Manager to own trafficking, tagging, and campaign QA across every paid channel our B2B team runs: Programmatic, Direct I/O, Paid Social, and Paid Search. The role is primarily dedicated to one of Wpromote's largest B2B accounts, a leading financial software company with multiple product lines and business units, with additional support across our other B2B clients as needed. Programmatic and direct buys will generate most of the day\-to\-day trafficking volume, but you'll be the single point of accountability for tracking and campaign setup across all channels, so the team has one consistent standard rather than channel\-by\-channel workarounds. You'll work alongside our channel teams, Client Service, and Analytics as the person who makes sure every campaign is set up correctly, tracked accurately, and launched on time.



This is a hands\-on technical role. You'll traffic creatives, build and QA tags, troubleshoot tracking issues, and keep the measurement plumbing clean so the media and analytics teams can trust the data. B2B campaigns often involve long conversion paths, multiple tracking systems, and lead data that has to flow cleanly from ad click to CRM, so you'll need to be comfortable working across ad servers, tag managers, platform pixels, and marketing automation tools.



At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work\-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people\-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.


Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

In this role, you will own contractual service\-level performance, reporting and analytics, incident management, including coordination of major incident response, and monitoring of operational process execution. You will ensure service desk and business operations functions, including incident management, service requests, and support services, are delivered in alignment with service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and customer experience expectations. * Identify inefficiencies and drive process optimization and standardization
* Establish and enforce change control and communication practices for process updates

* Partner closely with Service Experience Owners to translate quality insights into process, technology, and training improvements
* Partner with Knowledge Enablement to ensure training programs align to operational needs, performance trends, and service changes
* Partner with Platform and Process Owners to align engagement and interaction in Service Desk escalation processes
* Integrate training strategies with quality findings, process updates, and new technology implementations
* Other responsibilities as assigned

**What we're looking for:**


* 10 years of relevant experience in business process ownership, documenting, executing or automating
* 1 year of experience leading teams and operational functions in a complex service environment
* Advanced knowledge of service workflows, and support models
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field or equivalent of experience in lieu of degree
* Experience managing service delivery in large, complex environments, including managed service

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**The Role:**

JD Power’s Analytics team of over 200 professionals uses a hybrid, customized version of SAFe (scaled agile framework) to coordinate, execute and measure quarterly product development plans through planned cycles (program increments) to deliver value faster and more predictably. This role is responsible for the execution and ongoing optimization of that approach across sets of analytics professionals including data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, data insights analysts, data visualization and QA analysts, and data strategists. You will also interface heavily with partner teams in product and technology organizations as we move towards more consistent approaches across these teams. This is a high\-intensity, high\-visibility execution role involving the creation of net\-new data\-driven, AI\- and ML\-based products with our diverse set of automotive data assets.  



The role also evaluates, reports and conducts retrospectives on Analytics team operational KPIs for several of our major product areas involving our most complex, real\-time data sets that have high customer expectations and very fast customer response times. These metrics involve product quality, throughput, model accuracy and other identifiers. You will partner with Analytics leaders to identify, root cause and improve business performance, and evaluate and measure the impact of use of AI in our development teams.  



This role sits within the Transformation Office, the enterprise function responsible for orchestrating the programs and initiatives that underpin our three\-year strategy. In this capacity, you will be a dedicated execution partner to our CDAO, embedded in the work that matters most and positioned to grow alongside it.  



**The Impact You Will Have in This Role:**

Data and analytics are core to what JD Power sells and how we operate, particularly as our data assets and product development roadmaps have grown more complex and connected across multiple data sources. Your involvement in this position will ensure clarity of product development purpose and enable teams to effectively plan and ultimately own their development commitments. The Project Manager in this role is not a coordinator. You are voice of the Analytics organization in relation to what we shipped, what we will ship, how confident we are in doing so, and whether our quality, throughput and accuracy are performing to expectations.  



**What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:**

· Facilitate program increment quarterly planning events to align teams on a shared mission, objectives and delivery commitments each quarter. Lead inspect \& adapt workshops, facilitating quantitative and qualitative retrospectives and executing on improvement ideas


· Track and communicate metrics like completion rates, program predictability, to provide transparency and drive continuous improvement


· Leading end\-to\-end program delivery by coordinating across multiple teams and functions, adapting to methodologies as needed including Agile, hybrid, and data platform\-specific workflows


· Building, maintaining, and owning the committed project plan and schedule, distinct from the product roadmap, and ensuring milestones are met with transparency and rigor


· Drive adoption and maturity of product planning practices across the organization


· Applying a hybrid toolkit – technical project management, agile delivery, and business analysis to address the specific needs of each workstream


· Bring technical project management expertise to address engineering and AI challenges, working closely with technical leads and data scientists to monitor development progress and ensure alignment between business objectives and technical execution.


· Partner with Analytics leaders to set annual KPI objectives for year\-on\-year improvements. Proactively measure and report out on those KPIs and partner with technical teams to uncover root causes, implement retrospective actions and identify risks and countermeasures  



**What You Bring**

· 5\-8 years of project management experience


· Highly accountable, you own your commitments, follow through without being chased, and hold others to the same standard


· A self\-starter who can operate with limited direction, identify what needs to happen next, and move without waiting to be told


· Strong communication skills, able to distill complex program status into clear, concise updates for leadership audiences, both written and verbal


· Experience in technology\-centric environments (software development, IT, or data) with a history of bridging business objectives and technical execution


· Proficiency in SAFe a plus. Proficiency in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, generally speaking; experience with Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar SDLC and PM tools


· Demonstrated experience applying AI tools to program and project management workflows, and a track record of proactively exploring and adopting emerging AI capabilities to improve team productivity and decision\-making


· Strong RAID discipline, schedule management, budget oversight, and the instinct to track details without losing sight of the bigger picture.


· Comfortable managing multiple workstreams concurrently in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment


· Bachelor's degree preferred; PMP certification a plus


· North American based, with availability to work across a distributed global team.  



This position has a starting salary range of **$75,000 – $90,000 USD / 75,000 – 123,000 CAD** per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

jobs.description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS \& EPMS solutions for mission\-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program\-level governance.

  

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high\-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

 **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

 **Position Title:** Project Manager \- Special Projects and Innovation

**Position Location:** Remote \- work virtually from anywhere in the United States, with travel to job sites and lab environments

 **JOB SUMMARY**

  

Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS \& EPMS solutions for mission\-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program\-level governance. The Special Projects and Innovation (SPI) group is where we pursue the ideas that do not fit inside a standard project: rapid proofs of concept, emerging technology evaluations, and first\-of\-their\-kind monitoring and analytics platforms for critical facilities.

  

As a Project Manager you will oversee the pursuit and delivery of SPI initiatives, from data pipelines and full\-stack applications for AI\-enabled data center monitoring to IoT sensor networks that stand up in the field in hours. You will guide initiatives from whiteboard concept through lab prototype, field pilot, and handoff to long\-term owners, coordinating technical leads, vendors, and project resources while managing budgets, schedules, and capacity across concurrent efforts.

  

The Project Manager will self\-direct on day\-to\-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. May coordinate activities of other personnel.

  

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

 **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

 **Program Oversight and Coordination (30%)**

* Ingest and evaluate unique initiatives entering the SPI pipeline
* Track resource allocation, budgets, and capacity across concurrent initiatives
* Identify, escalate, and drive resolution of project risks and blockers
* Coordinate across technical leads, vendors, project resources, and stakeholders to keep initiatives on schedule

 **Documentation and Reporting (20%)**

* Enforce regular reporting among the project team and review summaries and reports
* Draft program\-level summary reports and present during regular project updates
* Maintain documentation standards for product delivery

 **Implementation (20%)**

* Travel to job sites for system demonstrations and field pilots
* Coordinate cross\-functional resources to keep implementation on schedule

 **Project Closeout and Lifecycle (20%)**

* Facilitate the handoff of mature initiatives to long\-term owners and archive project documentation
* Coordinate project postmortems and lessons\-learned reviews for continuous program improvement
* Serve as the point of contact for client satisfaction and product lifecycle

 **Technology, Digital Tools \& AI\-Enabled Efficiency (10%)**

* Leverage AI\-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high\-quality work output
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance
* Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization

 **Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget**

*Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned*

 **POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)**

* Program and project management of multiple concurrent technical initiatives, including budgets, schedules, and resource allocation
* Project management and work tracking tools such as Smartsheet or similar
* Backlog and ticketing tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar
* Risk and blocker identification, escalation, and resolution across cross\-functional teams
* Vendor and stakeholder coordination, including scope, procurement, and delivery tracking
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle and BAS / IoT systems sufficient to coordinate engineering resources and review technical progress
* Knowledge of IoT and smart building solutions
* Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), knowledge of file management
* Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self\-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
* Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
* Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company\-wide innovation
* Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
* Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non\-technical information)
* Ability to communicate effectively directly with stakeholders and at times serve as primary point of client contact
* Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
* Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
* Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
* Ability

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Overview  
We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Project Manager to lead and coordinate complex infrastructure projects within the construction industry. This role offers an exciting opportunity to oversee all phases of project execution, from initial planning through completion, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, extensive construction management experience, and proficiency with industry\-standard project management tools. Join us to drive impactful projects that shape communities and infrastructure while advancing your career in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment.

Duties

* Lead the planning, scheduling, and execution of construction projects using project management software such as Primavera P6, ProCore, and Microsoft Office tools.
* Develop detailed construction schedules and coordinate project timelines to ensure timely delivery of milestones.
* Manage project budgets, cost estimates, and financial tracking using HeavyBid, Prolog, and other construction estimating tools.
* Oversee the preparation and review of construction plans, schematics, blueprints, and regulatory compliance documentation.
* Coordinate with clients, contractors, subcontractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless communication and project alignment.
* Monitor construction site activities to ensure adherence to safety standards, building codes, and environmental regulations.
* Manage contracts, change orders, and procurement processes while maintaining accurate project documentation.
* Lead project teams by assigning tasks, managing schedules, and ensuring effective collaboration across all stakeholders.
* Conduct regular site visits to assess progress, resolve issues promptly, and ensure quality standards are met.
* Utilize construction management software such as Primavera P6 and Prolog for project scheduling, resource allocation, and progress tracking.

Qualifications

* Proven experience managing large\-scale infrastructure or commercial construction projects with a focus on civil or heavy civil works.
* Strong proficiency in construction management software including Primavera P6, ProCore, Bluebeam, Civil 3D, HeavyBid, Prolog, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Extensive knowledge of construction estimating techniques and cost management practices.
* Demonstrated ability to read blueprints, schematics, and construction plans accurately.
* Hands\-on experience with construction site supervision and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Excellent project scheduling skills with a track record of managing complex timelines effectively.
* Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining high standards of safety and quality.
* Strong understanding of contracts, legal considerations in construction projects, and project coordination processes.
* Effective time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks efficiently under tight deadlines.
* Construction regulatory knowledge relevant to local codes and industry standards; commercial construction experience is preferred.

Join us to lead transformative infrastructure projects that make a lasting impact! We value energetic professionals who thrive on challenge and innovation — if you’re ready to elevate your career in project management within the construction sector, we want to hear from you!

Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**Summary**

Responsible for the planning and management of multiple projects through entire life cycle, executing within framework of approved Statement of Work (SOW) and the Logicalis PMO project delivery methodology resulting in predictable outcomes. Leads IT Professional Services teams in design, planning, management, implementation, and delivery of Microsoft technology service offerings *(M365 migrations, Identity Services/Active Directory, CoPilot, InTune, Security, etc.)* on time, within budget and providing exceptional customer service. Primary activities include project planning and coordination, internal and external communications, project cost management, and leading client and internal technical project teams.
  

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

• Demonstrates a deep understanding of Microsoft technology service offerings *(M365 migrations, Identity Services/Active Directory, CoPilot, InTune, Security, etc.)*

• Planning, scheduling, and directing day\-to\-day activities of assigned engagements, recording, and communicating essential project activity and status information utilizing and Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies as applicable to the offering delivered.


* Directs, communicates, and exhibits exceptional leadership behaviors to manage effective delivery of services and processes.

• Conducts project planning, execution, controlling, and closing activities in accordance with Logicalis Project Management Methodology.


* Oversees any third\-party vendors or partners’ deliverables to Logicalis in coordination with vendor PM.

* Ensures effective management throughout life of engagement as follows:

*Process Management:* Operates in a manner consistent with established policies and procedures; ensures time entry is performed per policy by service delivery consultants; ensures resources are scheduled and performing work as assigned and planned; oversight of workflow management, appropriate use of tools and processes to support delivery of the services, all in accordance with policies.


*Scope Management:* Ensures planning and execution of tasks, activities, and deliverables are consistent with the requirements defined in the SOW. When new scope is introduced, leads the Change Management effort and development of a Project Change Request.


*Project Budget Management:* Ensures project budget is met or exceeded, all invoices are generated and submitted in timely manner, and monitors and communicates Earned Value throughout the life of the project.


*Schedule Management:* Creates and maintains master project plan; compares actual progress with planned milestones, analyzes variances, and takes corrective action as needed to maintain schedule adherence; tracks and communicates progress to the team and stakeholders.
  

  

*Risk/Issue Management:* Applies continuous risk management protocols. Identifies and documents known risks throughout engagement, applying appropriate mitigation strategies

  

*Communications Management:* Responsible for development of a project Communication Plan to define the cadence and content for project meetings, status reporting, escalation management, etc., for customers, stakeholders, and the project team.
  

  

*Quality Management* : Ensures deliverables are substantiated, validated, and provided to customer per terms of the SOW and that the customer is satisfied with the services provided.

  

* Demonstrates deep understanding of project management methodologies, practices, tools, and techniques; effective leadership and applies appropriate collaboration skills while working in a matrixed environment.
* Documents and shares lessons learned to support continuous process improvement.
* Maintains knowledge of relevant technologies and the Logicalis Service Portfolio and able to understand common IT industry terminology in support of projects assigned.

  

• Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis and exhibits behaviors consistent with the organization's values.

  

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

  

**Education/Experience/Technical Requirements/Certifications**

**Equivalent combination accepted.**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in a related field and formal Project Management Training

  

**Experience / Technical Requirements:**

* 5 or more years of enterprise\-level project management experience, managing multiple projects at one time for multiple external customers, managing teams of 1 to 20\+ resources, delivering enterprise Msft service offerings.
* Proficient use of all Microsoft Office applications including Microsoft Project or Smartsheet, and experience working within Project and/or PS business applications to plan, manage, and report on project services delivered.

**Certifications:**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred.
* CAPM, SCRUM, Msft and/or IT industry technical certifications beneficial.

Leveraging our executive team's military experience and private and public sector consulting expertise, Blue Water Thinking takes an integrated "one\-team" approach and brings to bear best\-fit solutions, thought leadership, and grit to meet our client's transformational needs.



Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.

jobs.description:
Synergy Business Innovation \& Solutions is a premier implementer of cutting\-edge software solutions. Synergy brings the experience and expertise necessary to deliver capability that provides tangible ROI to our customers. Our core areas of expertise are in the fields of Digital Transformation, Cloud Solutions, SaaS and Low\-Code/No\-Code Solutions, Emerging Technologies, Data Analytics and Visualization, Information Assurance, and Business Process Re\-Engineering.


Synergy offers its employees a generous portfolio of core and voluntary benefits including: group medical, dental, and vision insurance, company paid life, short\-term, and long\-term disability insurance, HSA, FSA, 401(k) with company match, PTO \& Bonus Leave, 11 paid federal holidays, parental leave, tuition and training reimbursement, a referral bonus program, and well\-being programs.


At Synergy, you’ll be challenged and given the opportunity to grow in your career path. In fact, growth is such a big deal to us that we have career mentors available for every employee, company\-funded certification opportunities, education reimbursement, and a general open\-door policy so that you have support when you need it. Our team is eager to learn, fast\-paced, and quality\-driven. If that sounds like you, Synergy has a position for you!


This position is designated as \[hybrid or work\-from\-home].

**About the Role:**


Synergy Business Innovation \& Solutions, Inc. is seeking a Sr. Program Manager to lead and oversee complex IT information systems engineering and systems integration projects. In this role, you will serve as the primary liaison between government leadership and contractor teams, guiding technical direction across all phases of the Systems Engineering Life Cycle (SELC).


The ideal candidate brings strong leadership skills, deep technical authority in cloud and systems engineering, and a proven track record of controlling project cost, schedule, and performance while driving continuous process improvement and change management.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Program Leadership \& Task Management: Organize, schedule, and assign responsibilities to subordinate technical and functional staff; oversee day\-to\-day operations and completion of all IT project tasks.
* Government \& Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the primary interface between Government management personnel and contractor leadership, delivering clear written and oral status reports.
* Technical \& Governance Authority: Provide overarching technical direction for system development, integration, and cloud management initiatives; serve as a subject matter authority for technical design and issue resolution.
* Planning \& Execution: Ensure the development, implementation, and maintenance of Program Management Plans and Technical Specifications Plans that guide all technical and functional project activities.
* Cost \& Schedule Control: Monitor performance metrics to ensure all deliverables meet quality standards while staying within estimated cost and timeline baselines.

jobs.title: Project Manager (SaaS Implementations)
jobs.description:
Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed \& Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.


Bullhorn is a fast\-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.


**About the role**

The **Project Manager** is a key position within Professional Services and the PMO and acts with integrity and leads by example, serving as the primary point of contact throughout the customer engagement lifecycle. This role is accountable for ensuring the right resources, governance, and methodologies are in place to enable successful planning, execution, and delivery of complex core SaaS system implementations for our clients, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, on budget, and with high CSAT scores.


In this capacity, the Project Manager partners closely with Customers, Sales Executives, Solution Consultants, Solution Architects, and Software Engineers to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and deliverables align with defined success criteria. By applying project management best practices and adhering to Bullhorn’s PMO processes, the Senior Project Manager defines, drives, and manages the delivery of projects, managing scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and stakeholder expectations to ensure an exceptional customer experience from project initiation through closure.  

  



**A typical day will include...**
---------------------------------

* **Owning the Project Lifecycle:** Lead the planning, execution, and closure of multiple, concurrent, large\-scale client software implementation projects, establishing the necessary governance and structure where none exists.
* **Proactively Drive Clarity and Order:** Quickly assess and gain command over complex, ambiguous, and high\-risk projects, translating chaos into defined, manageable, and executable project plans.
* **Ultimate Accountability:** Serve as the single point of accountability for project status and success. Naturally take ownership of problems and aggressively drive solutions to resolution.
* **Rigorous Risk and Scope Management:** Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks, dependencies, and issues. Firmly manage scope creep and hold both internal and client stakeholders accountable to agreed\-upon project plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Executive\-Level Communicatio** n: Manage client and vendor relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for project status, expectations, and issue resolution with executive and C\-level stakeholders.
* **Financial and Resource Control:** Oversee project budgets, tracking hours and expenses to ensure financial targets are met and providing accurate, predictable and insightful forecasting and reporting.
* **Methodology Adherence:** Apply project management best practices and actively contribute to the development, improvement and standardization of Bullhorn's PMO processes.
* Mentoring and provide guidance to junior project managers or implementation specialists on best practices and project governance.

**This role is a fit for you if...**
------------------------------------

* Have 3\+ years of progressive experience managing complex, external client\-facing software implementation projects, with a significant focus on ERP, HCM, CRM, or large\-scale SaaS solutions with billable utilization targets.
* A proven track record of successfully delivering projects that have a high level of complexity and ambiguity, demonstrating the ability to rapidly impose structure and governance.
* An expertise in defining and managing project scope, schedules, and budgets for large enterprise clients.
* A mastery of various project management methodologies ( *e.g.,* Waterfall, Scrum, Hybrid) and knowing when to apply each to achieve stability.
* A solid understanding of the end\-to\-end implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, configuration, data migration, integration, testing (UAT), and go\-live.
* Have a proficiency with modern project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, SmartSheet) and resource management systems.
* PMP, CSM, or equivalent is highly preferred.

The annual base salary range for this position is $92,002 \- $115,000\. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual target bonus \& a comprehensive benefits package.


**Compensation and Transparency Statement**

The posted range represents the good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. Actual pay within the range will be based on factors such as, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business or organizational needs and affordability. In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request

jobs.title: VA Center for Care & Payment Innovation Task Order Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Requisition ID: 2026\-4649 Job Summary:**  

As the Task Order (TO) Project Manager for the Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI) Strategic Planning Division (SPD) support contract, you will serve as the primary interface with the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) and lead all aspects of program and project management support for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). Operating within VA's federal healthcare environment under the Strategic Planning Division's innovation engine within Planning, Innovation \& Modernization (PIM), you will oversee the planning, execution, tracking, and reporting of task order deliverables to ensure mission\-aligned outcomes that directly support Veterans' care and benefits programs of data\-driven and value\-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden.
  
  

The ideal candidate is a disciplined, results\-oriented project management professional who thrives in complex federal healthcare environments, communicates with clarity at the executive level, and proactively manages risk, schedules, and stakeholder relationships with minimal direction.
  
  

**Primary Responsibilities:**  

Serve as the single, authoritative point of contact for all COR communications, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional responses to Government inquiries, direction, and feedback throughout the life of the task order.
  
  

Develop, maintain, and report on comprehensive project management artifacts including project plans, integrated master schedules (IMS), risk registers, and status reports in compliance with VA and federal contracting standards.
  
  

Produce and deliver executive\-level program management deliverables, including briefings, dashboards, monthly status reports, and milestone reviews, tailored for senior VA leadership and Government stakeholders.
  
  

Lead internal team coordination and cross\-functional collaboration to ensure all task order workstreams remain on schedule, within scope, and aligned to contract performance requirements and PWS objectives.
  
  

Identify, assess, and manage program risks and issues; develop mitigation strategies and escalate critical items to the COR and company leadership in a timely and structured manner.
  
  

Report to the VA Central Office at 810 Vermont Ave NW, Washington, DC upon Government request, supporting on\-site meetings, reviews, and engagements without charging travel expenses to the Government.
  
  

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

Minimum of 4 years of federal healthcare program and/or project management experience, with a demonstrated track record of managing multi\-workstream task orders or contracts within a federal agency environment.
  
  

Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) from an accredited institution required; Project Management Professional (PMP) certification through PMI is required and must be active and in good standing at time of hire.
  
  

Demonstrated experience supporting or working directly with federal healthcare agencies (e.g., VA, DoD/DoW, HHS, CMS), including familiarity with federal contracting vehicles, COR relationships, and Government program oversight processes.
  
  

Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and satisfy all applicable VA background investigation and suitability requirements prior to performing work.
  
  

Must be authorized to work in the United States; this position does not offer visa sponsorship.
  
  

Must reside within reasonable commuting distance of VA Central Office at 810 Vermont Ave NW, Washington, DC and be available to report on\-site at the Government's request without travel reimbursement from the Government.
  
  

**Desired Qualifications:**  

* Prior VA\-specific program management experience, particularly supporting VA Central Office (VACO) initiatives, the Office of Community Care, or VA healthcare transformation programs such as CCPI or related and value\-based health care solutions or innovation efforts. • Familiarity with development of VA data\-driven and value\-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden and/or connecting pilot design, resourcing, evaluation, strategic planning, and enterprise decision\-making. • Experience managing deliverables under federal Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts and producing compliant Program Management Reviews (PMRs) or Integrated Baseline Reviews (IBRs). • Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent scheduling and reporting platforms used in federal program environments. • Advanced degree (MBA, MPA, or MS in a related field) or additional certifications such as FAC\-P/PM, PgMP, or a Lean/Agile credential applicable to federal healthcare delivery.

**About the team**
------------------

The HR Compliance team is part of Zillow's Employee Service \& Operations (ES\&O) organization. ES\&O focuses on delivering scalable, reliable services that support employees and managers across the company, bringing together operational expertise, systems, and shared services that enable Zillow's people processes to run smoothly.
  

Within ES\&O, the HR Compliance team serves as Zillow's center of expertise for HR compliance — establishing the standards, guardrails, and governance frameworks that keep people practices legally sound as the business grows. The team partners closely with the broader People organization, Legal, and other shared services to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical guidance, enabling operational teams to execute compliantly and consistently.
**About the role**
------------------

The Program Manager, HR Compliance is a subject matter expert responsible for helping strengthen Zillow's HR compliance program across a defined and expanding portfolio of programs.


This role supports regulatory monitoring, risk assessment, and policy governance work that allows the team to monitor and respond to changes in employment laws and regulations, identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risk, and equip HR partners with the guidance they need to operate compliantly. You will establish standards, playbooks, and controls for teams to execute against.


**You Will:**
-------------

* Monitor new and emerging employment regulations across U.S. federal, state, and international jurisdictions
* Develop and maintain a compliance register and ownership mapping, ensuring risks and obligations are documented, assigned, and tracked
* Develop and maintain compliance playbooks and operating standards that serve as the authoritative reference for operational teams executing programs
* Support international employment compliance governance across multiple jurisdictions, partnering with regional HR and People Legal on country\-specific regulatory obligations

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**


Adeptus Solutions, Inc. is seeking a Business Analyst to support technology and software development initiatives within a SAFe Agile environment. The Business Analyst will work closely with stakeholders, Product Management, developers, QA, Scrum Masters, and project leadership to understand business needs, analyze processes, capture business rules, and translate requirements into actionable Agile work items in Azure DevOps (ADO).
The ideal candidate can bridge the gap between business and technical teams by turning complex business processes and requirements into clear, testable, and traceable features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Elicit, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Map and document current\-state and future\-state business processes, including workflows, decision points, actors, system interactions, and dependencies.
* Identify, document, and maintain business rules, policies, conditions, and system behaviors that govern business processes.
* Translate business requirements, process models, and business rules into SAFe/Agile features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and ADO work items.
* Create and maintain requirements in Azure DevOps (ADO) and ensure work items accurately reflect approved business needs and scope.
* Decompose complex requirements into appropriately sized, actionable user stories that can be developed and tested within an iteration.
* Develop clear, measurable, and testable acceptance criteria that define expected system behavior and business outcomes.
* Maintain requirements traceability from business needs and business rules through features, user stories, development, testing, and acceptance.
* Collaborate with Product Management and Product Owners to support backlog development, prioritization, refinement, and readiness.
* Participate in SAFe PI Planning, backlog refinement, iteration planning, system demos, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and working sessions with business and technical stakeholders.
* Analyze requirements and processes to identify gaps, inconsistencies, dependencies, risks, and impacts.
* Work directly with developers and technical teams to clarify requirements, business rules, workflows, and expected system behavior.
* Partner with QA to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria provide a sufficient basis for test planning and validation.
* Review proposed solutions and developed functionality to verify alignment with approved requirements and business processes.
* Analyze proposed changes and document their impact on requirements, processes, functionality, scope, and downstream systems.
* Develop and maintain process flows, workflow diagrams, business rules catalogs, functional requirements, requirements traceability matrices, and other BA artifacts.
* Ensure requirements and supporting documentation remain current and synchronized with ADO and the approved product backlog.
* Identify and communicate requirements\-related risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Support continuous improvement of business analysis, requirements management, and Agile delivery practices.

  

**Skills and Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related field, and four years of experience as a Business Analyst or related role.
* Demonstrated experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements, technical requirements, and business rules.
* Experience developing current\-state and future\-state process maps and documenting business workflows.
* Experience translating requirements and process analysis into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and Agile work items.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) or a comparable requirements and Agile work\-management platform.
* Experience working within a SAFe Agile and/or Agile/Scrum environment.
* Understanding of software development lifecycles and the relationship between requirements, development, QA, deployment, and operational support.
* Strong understanding of requirements traceability and requirements management.
* Ability to analyze complex business processes and translate them into clear, actionable requirements for technical teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to effectively communicate with business stakeholders, Product Management, Product Owners, developers, QA, Scrum Masters, and project leadership.
* Experience with process modeling and diagramming tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or similar platforms.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud technologies, APIs, system integrations, databases, data flows, or technical architectures is preferred.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* SAFe certification or demonstrated experience working within a SAFe Agile Release Train (ART).
* Experience supporting PI Planning and iteration planning.
* Experience managing and refining product backlogs in ADO.
* Experience developing business rules, process models, requirements traceability, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience working directly with software development and QA teams.
* Experience with complex technical systems, integrations, APIs, data flows, or cloud\-based applications.
* Agile, SAFe, Scrum, ITIL, PMP, or related certification.

jobs.title: Lead, Channel Enablement
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**

‎


Commercial Organization \| GTM Enablement
  

Reports to: Director, GTM Enablement
  

  

The Lead, Channel Enablement owns the enablement strategy and infrastructure that helps Castlight\-powered solutions get sold effectively through our channel ecosystem, including health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace relationships.
  

  

This role is the Commercial owner of the second sale enablement motion and the connective tissue across Castlight, our partners, and the teams responsible for bringing our solutions to market. The Lead builds the training, demos, tools, and repeatable programs that allow partner sellers and Castlight teams to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Castlight\-powered solutions at scale.
  

  

The role also owns the core demo infrastructure supporting channel selling, ensuring our Figma environments, screen libraries, and partner\-specific experiences stay current as the product evolves.
‎


**How will you make an impact \& Requirements**

‎


**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Channel \& Partner Enablement**
---------------------------------

* Build and own the channel enablement strategy across health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace partners.
* Develop scalable enablement programs that help partner sellers understand the buyer problem, articulate the Castlight value proposition, demonstrate the solution, and advance opportunities.
* Create partner\-ready training programs, playbooks, talk tracks, FAQs, objection handling, templates, and selling tools using Product Marketing's approved positioning and messaging.
* Partner with Strategic Partnerships to build tailored enablement programs based on partner type, commercial model, seller audience, and go\-to\-market motion.
* Support the launch and ongoing readiness of new partner relationships and Castlight\-powered offerings.

**Second Sale Enablement**
--------------------------

* Own the enablement framework for the second sale motion across health plan and partner channels.
* Establish one source of truth for second sale training, demos, tools, templates, and selling standards.
* Prepare Castlight Commercial and Client teams for the transition of second sale execution to Client CSMs by September 30\.
* Build repeatable training and certification approaches that allow Client teams to execute consistently while maintaining Commercial standards.
* Create scalable processes for Commercial review, feedback, and continuous improvement as execution moves closer to the client and health plan teams.

**Demo Strategy \& Engineering**
--------------------------------

* Own the core demo environments supporting health plan, partner, reseller, and second sale motions.
* Build and maintain Figma\-based demos, screen libraries, reusable components, and partner\-specific demo experiences.
* Maintain demo environments as products, capabilities, positioning, and user experiences evolve.
* Lead Nova conversions across the existing channel book and establish the standards for new partner implementations.
* Manage partner access to demo environments and establish clear governance around version control, usage, and updates.
* Coordinate external design or Figma resources as needed to maintain and scale the demo platform.
* Establish a regular operating cadence with Product, UX, Solutions, and Product Marketing so demo experiences remain accurate and current.

**Cross\-Functional Enablement**
--------------------------------

* Translate Product Marketing's positioning and messaging into usable seller training, demos, and field tools.
* Partner with Strategic Partnerships to understand partner priorities, seller needs, and commercial opportunities.
* Partner with Client leadership to ensure second sale teams have the tools, training, and confidence required to execute.
* Partner with Solutions and Product teams to keep demonstrations accurate and identify opportunities to improve how Castlight capabilities are represented in market.
* Bring health plan, partner, seller, and field feedback back to Product Marketing, Product, Solutions, and Strategic Partnerships to improve messaging, products, and the partner experience.

**How Ownership Works**
-----------------------

This role operates across several teams, with clear ownership boundaries:


**Product Marketing** owns core positioning, messaging architecture, value propositions, competitive strategy, and master marketing assets.


**Channel Enablement** turns that strategy into training, demos, playbooks, tools, certification, and scalable seller experiences.


**Strategic Partnerships** owns partner strategy, relationships, commercial agreements, partner performance, and escalations.


**Client CSMs** own plan\-specific second sale execution, including training delivery to health plan sellers and ongoing maintenance of client\-specific materials.


**Solutions and Product** provide product expertise, roadmap input, and validation required to keep demonstrations technically accurate.


**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Partner sellers can confidently explain and demonstrate Castlight\-powered solutions without relying on Castlight for every selling interaction.
* Health plan and partner channels have consistent, current, easy\-to\-use enablement resources.
* Second sale execution successfully transitions to Client teams without losing quality or commercial consistency.
* Demo environments stay aligned with the live product and can be efficiently adapted across partners and channels.
* New partners can move from agreement to seller readiness through a repeatable enablement process.
* Feedback from partner and second sale motions consistently reaches the teams responsible for product, messaging, and commercial strategy.

* 4\+ years of experience in sales enablement, partner enablement, solutions consulting, product marketing su

new_jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager, Implementation & Accounts - Hospital Billing
new_jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.


Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”


Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.


The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**
------------------


Commure's RCM product grew up serving outpatient and ambulatory practices. We're now taking it into hospitals, and that's a different job: dozens of tax IDs, several EHRs, a revenue integrity team that tests you in week one, a CFO who wants a number by Friday. This role is the first hire on the Hospital Billing team, the function we're standing up this year to run those launches.


You'll own hospitals launches end to end, building the process while you're running it. Most roles at this level hand you a playbook. In this one you write it.


You won't do it alone. In addition to deep cross\-functional collaboration across Product, Eng, Operations, Sales, and Account Management teams you will work directly with the Hospital Billing GM to define and execute the critical business processes that are required to launch Commure’s largest and most complex customers. If you're coming from an implementation role elsewhere, the difference in scope is real: you keep the account and the number after go\-live.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own hospital launches end to end, from contract signature through stabilized production billing, as the named point of contact for the account
* Build the hospital launch playbook as you go: diligence playbooks, customer management workflows, detailed rule creation and configuration, and the automation needed to run it, none of which exists yet for hospital billing
* Work directly with a customer’s leadership and operations teams to translate enterprise complexity (multiple tax IDs, multiple EHRs, institutional adjudication rules) into smoothly executed implementation plans
* Coordinate daily with Commure's implementation, product, and payer enrollment teams so no account is carried solo
* Own the account after go\-live, driving stable and repeatable collections before transitioning the account to long term management
* Establish clear SLAs and a clean handoff process with the internal teams we partner with to power successful launches
* Help define what Launch and Account Management look like as separate functions within Hospital Billing as the team grows

**What You Have**
-----------------

* 6\+ years of experience in consulting, investment banking, or operations at a fast\-paced SaaS tech company
* A demonstrated history of creating opportunities for yourself and seeking ownership positions
* Comfortable working with data; proficiency in SQL and Excel. SQL or a robust analytical background (finance, consulting) is a plus
* Expertise in project management: you've deployed multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment

Technical Account Manager

BAY AREA · NORTHERN CALIFORNIA FULL\-TIME BASE \+ MILESTONE BONUSES \+ UNCAPPED COMMISSION

01\. ABOUT US

Trilion Quality Systems is a precision metrology and NDE company based in King of Prussia, PA, and the US representative for ZEISS IQS optical testing systems. Our sister company, Xi Analytics, develops real\-time optical metrology and AI\-based measurement technology for advanced material testing and aerospace structural applications.

As the exclusive ZEISS Certified Metrology Partner in North America, Trilion’s experienced team of thirty people has spent the last 30 years doing one thing: connecting physical measurement with certified digital insight. More than 90% of the top ten US aerospace, automotive, biomechanics, and electronics companies work with us as their ZEISS DIC partner. This means that you will spend most weeks on innovative projects at Fortune 100 aerospace, defense, automotive, and consumer electronics companies, on test articles that are usually confidential, and you will be the person they call first. We’re an agile team and you won’t waste months waiting on committees and layers of management.

02\. ABOUT THE ROLE

Trilion is opening a Bay Area office around San Mateo in 2026 and hiring a Technical Account Manager to carry Northern California. This is a quota\-carrying, field\-based role, and you will be the primary technical and commercial contact for customers in the territory from the first conversation through demonstration, proposal, purchase order, and long\-term account growth.

You will spend most of your week in front of engineers in their test labs, not behind a desk. Optical metrology is sold by showing it, so much of the job is setting up a system on a customer's test article and letting the data make the argument. Strain gauges read a handful of points and miss the concentrations and asymmetries that decide whether a design passes certification. Full\-field DIC makes every pixel a measurement point, in 3D, NIST\-traceable, and ready for FEA correlation in minutes.

You will not be just a coordinator who forwards technical questions. Once ramped, you are expected to be able to run standard demonstrations and beginner trainings yourself, with our expert engineering team behind you for complex projects, dedicated multi\-day training, and on\-site service work. The technical credibility that comes with it is how you sell on results and direct knowledge rather than on a brochure.

You will not be working a blank list. Leads reach you through ZEISS and through Trilion’s own marketing, and you will generate the rest yourself at proven trade shows, through customer referrals, and by developing accounts we already serve. Revenue splits close to evenly three ways: new accounts, new teams inside existing accounts, and recurring business from our customer base. This means that a majority of projects will come from customers who already know and trust us, which is why account management matters here as much as new business. 04\. ABOUT YOU

Your Role:


This position provides quality assurance oversight for cGMP manufacturing of advanced cell and gene therapy products. Ensures strict compliance with FDA, EMA, ISO and other applicable regulations through real\-time shop\-floor support, batch record review, and disposition of raw materials and final drug products. This position also supports the implementation of the quality systems in compliance with cGMPs and other company policies.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


* Perform review of batch records for intermediate or final product, cell banks including in\-process testing, QC release testing data packages, labeling, packaging, and all supporting documentation
* Inspect, review, and disposition raw materials, reagents and components
* Facilitate investigations relating to manufactured products and raw materials
* Provide QA oversight and QA on the floor support during GMP manufacturing operations
* Conduct line clearances, in\-process inspections, support final product packaging operations, etc.
* Assist cross\-functional teams with the initiation, investigation, and approval of Change Controls, Deviations, and CAPAs, providing critical QA input throughout.
* Create, review and revise standard operating procedures, study protocols, reports, and other GxP documents as needed.
* Coordinate the release of final cell\-based therapeutic products for clinical and commercial applications.

* Train and provide QA guidance to internal functional groups on Quality Systems.
* Provide environmental monitoring support as needed.
* Participate in internal and client facing meetings as needed.
* 8:00am to 5:00pm with irregular hours/weekends/nights.
* Other duties as assigned


Requirements:


* Bachelor’s degree in life science; 5\+ years of direct QA experience related to GMP Manufacturing in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience in cell\-based therapeutics or biopharmaceuticals preferred.
* Experience working with Quality Systems, writing deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls.
* Experience in supporting/assisting the internal and external audits, inspections.

* Strong knowledge of cGMPs and FDA, EMA, ICH, and ISO regulatory requirements.
* Knowledge of Quality Systems, including Deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls, document control, and training processes.

* Knowledge of validation and qualification activities, including IQ/OQ/PQ.
* Strong investigation, problem\-solving, and risk assessment skills.

* Ability to provide QA oversight in a GMP manufacturing environment.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
