**Location:** Santa Clara, CA \-This position requires regular on\-site presence at the primary location 3 days/week, at minimum.

Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job\-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance.

At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.


Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”


Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.


The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.


**About the Role**
------------------


Commure's RCM product grew up serving outpatient and ambulatory practices. We're now taking it into hospitals, and that's a different job: dozens of tax IDs, several EHRs, a revenue integrity team that tests you in week one, a CFO who wants a number by Friday. This role is the first hire on the Hospital Billing team, the function we're standing up this year to run those launches.


You'll own hospitals launches end to end, building the process while you're running it. Most roles at this level hand you a playbook. In this one you write it.


You won't do it alone. In addition to deep cross\-functional collaboration across Product, Eng, Operations, Sales, and Account Management teams you will work directly with the Hospital Billing GM to define and execute the critical business processes that are required to launch Commure’s largest and most complex customers. If you're coming from an implementation role elsewhere, the difference in scope is real: you keep the account and the number after go\-live.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Own hospital launches end to end, from contract signature through stabilized production billing, as the named point of contact for the account
* Build the hospital launch playbook as you go: diligence playbooks, customer management workflows, detailed rule creation and configuration, and the automation needed to run it, none of which exists yet for hospital billing
* Work directly with a customer’s leadership and operations teams to translate enterprise complexity (multiple tax IDs, multiple EHRs, institutional adjudication rules) into smoothly executed implementation plans
* Coordinate daily with Commure's implementation, product, and payer enrollment teams so no account is carried solo
* Own the account after go\-live, driving stable and repeatable collections before transitioning the account to long term management
* Establish clear SLAs and a clean handoff process with the internal teams we partner with to power successful launches
* Help define what Launch and Account Management look like as separate functions within Hospital Billing as the team grows

**What You Have**
-----------------


* 6\+ years of experience in consulting, investment banking, or operations at a fast\-paced SaaS tech company
* A demonstrated history of creating opportunities for yourself and seeking ownership positions
* Comfortable working with data; proficiency in SQL and Excel. SQL or a robust analytical background (finance, consulting) is a plus
* Expertise in project management: you've deployed multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable building process without a playbook: you're not looking for a role where the steps are already written down
* Project confidence: you can run a meeting with a health system CFO or revenue integrity team and hold your own on a hard subject
* Confident with ambiguity: you're autonomous, you prioritize well, and you spot blockers before they become escalations
* Energized by people, relentless about finding the truth in a customer's ask rather than the easy answer
* Healthcare or RCM experience is a plus, not a filter.

Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS \& EPMS solutions for mission\-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program\-level governance.

  

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high\-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

 **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

 **Position Title:** Project Manager \- Special Projects and Innovation

**Position Location:** Remote \- work virtually from anywhere in the United States, with travel to job sites and lab environments

 **JOB SUMMARY**

  

Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS \& EPMS solutions for mission\-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program\-level governance. The Special Projects and Innovation (SPI) group is where we pursue the ideas that do not fit inside a standard project: rapid proofs of concept, emerging technology evaluations, and first\-of\-their\-kind monitoring and analytics platforms for critical facilities.

  

As a Project Manager you will oversee the pursuit and delivery of SPI initiatives, from data pipelines and full\-stack applications for AI\-enabled data center monitoring to IoT sensor networks that stand up in the field in hours. You will guide initiatives from whiteboard concept through lab prototype, field pilot, and handoff to long\-term owners, coordinating technical leads, vendors, and project resources while managing budgets, schedules, and capacity across concurrent efforts.

  

The Project Manager will self\-direct on day\-to\-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. May coordinate activities of other personnel.

  

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

 **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

 **Program Oversight and Coordination (30%)**

* Ingest and evaluate unique initiatives entering the SPI pipeline
* Track resource allocation, budgets, and capacity across concurrent initiatives
* Identify, escalate, and drive resolution of project risks and blockers
* Coordinate across technical leads, vendors, project resources, and stakeholders to keep initiatives on schedule

 **Documentation and Reporting (20%)**

* Enforce regular reporting among the project team and review summaries and reports
* Draft program\-level summary reports and present during regular project updates
* Maintain documentation standards for product delivery

 **Implementation (20%)**

* Travel to job sites for system demonstrations and field pilots
* Coordinate cross\-functional resources to keep implementation on schedule

 **Project Closeout and Lifecycle (20%)**

* Facilitate the handoff of mature initiatives to long\-term owners and archive project documentation
* Coordinate project postmortems and lessons\-learned reviews for continuous program improvement
* Serve as the point of contact for client satisfaction and product lifecycle

* Leverage AI\-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high\-quality work output
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance
* Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization

 **Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget**

*Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned*

* Project management and work tracking tools such as Smartsheet or similar
* Backlog and ticketing tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar

We help reduce avoidable healthcare costs, improve clinical outcomes, and create a best\-in\-class patient experience.
If you're passionate about transforming healthcare and delivering meaningful care to those who need it most, Greater Good Health offers a purpose\-driven, collaborative, and supportive environment where your work can make a lasting impact.

  

**The Role:**
The GGH Patient Engagement Specialist (PES) plays a critical role as the point of contact to engage patients and connect them to care. Successful PESs are excellent communicators, empathetic, and have a strong work ethic and desire to positively impact the quality of care delivered by GGH. They are welcoming and courteous, have superior active listening and critical thinking skills, and are comfortable with multitasking and problem\-solving. Patient Engagement Specialists must also be able to relate to the geriatric population, build trust, and make them feel comfortable.
**Typical duties of a Patient Engagement Specialist include:**
* Outreaching to and scheduling patient home, telehealth, and in\-clinic visits to complete their Annual Wellness Visits. These visits ensure patients receive timely preventative care and build care plans around existing health conditions
* Accepting inbound calls from patients to schedule Annual Wellness Visits (AWVs)
* Handling protected health information (PHI); and adhering to the general standards set forth by HIPAA
* Partnering with GGH Nurse Practitioners (NP) to manage their day\-to\-day patient schedules, coordinating patient cancellations, reschedules, and add\-ons with the NP.
* Building a logical driving route for the GGH Nurse Practitioner to complete their home visits that optimizes the time the NP spends with their patients
* Connecting with the geriatric population to build trust, answer questions, and make them feel comfortable, calm, and supported
* Outreaching to patients to complete key preventative screenings (Colon Cancer Screening, Mammograms, Diabetic Retina scans, HbA1c, and more), documenting outreach and establishing follow through plan.
* Building a strong positive relationship with GGH Nurse Practitioners and maintaining professional communications with our client partners and Nurse Practitioners
* Coordinating referrals and activities for high\-risk programs
* Maintaining collaborative relationships with clinicians and the leadership team to help develop new programs to improve patient engagement
* Other duties as assigned

**Key Success Outcomes for Patient Engagement Specialists**
* Completing 50\-100 outbound calls per day
* Achieving conversion rate expectations
* Building and maintaining strong professional relationships with the PES team and GGH Nurse Practitioners
* Timely, accurate and thorough documentation
* Meeting and exceeding call quality standards

**Requirements**
* 1\-2 years of post\-high school education or a degree from a two\-year college
* 1\-3 years of experience working in standard operating systems (Windows, MS Word, MS Excel, Internet, and other applicable systems.)
* 1\-3 years of experience working in a call center, preferably sales related.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Outstanding phone skills with sensitivity towards protected health information (PHI).
* Must be organized, detail\-oriented, and be able to multi\-task
* Must be adaptable and a team player
* Professionalism in appearance, communication, and demeanor
* Must be able to work independently with limited supervision
* Solid problem\-solving skills

**Preferred**
* Healthcare experience in a patient\-facing role (Strongly Preferred)
* Basic Excel skills to be able to navigate, data entry, filter, and sort data
* 1\+ years of experience with Medicare/Senior population
* 1\+ years of call center experience and managing phone queues
* Experience with HEDIS Gap Closure
* Phone sales experience
* Strong preference for bilingual (English/Spanish)

**Perks and Benefits**
* **Competitive Compensation Package:** We offer a competitive compensation package (guaranteed hourly rate \+ bonus where you can earn up to $24\.40/hr)
* **Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits:** Take advantage of comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, and vision benefits, to prioritize your health and well\-being. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) and Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) available
* **Paid Time Off and Parental Leave:** Enjoy paid holidays, vacation time, and paid parental leave to maintain a healthy work\-life balance and spend quality time with your loved ones
* **401K Program with Company Match:** Plan for your future with our 401K program, featuring a company match, to help you save for retirement
* **Monthly Phone/Internet Reimbursement:** Stay connected with our monthly phone and internet reimbursement, ensuring you have the tools you need to excel in your role
* **Wellness Resources:** Access wellness resources, including BetterHelp, the Calm app, and Quarterly Wellness Events, to support your physical, mental, and emotional well\-being
* **Comprehensive Life and AD\&D Coverage:** Enjoy peace of mind with 100% premiums covered by GGH for Basic Life and Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) insurance for full\-time team m

new_jobs.description:
**Why Housecall Pro?**



Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America's 100 million homes. We're all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.



While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they're based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members' careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.


We also offer:

* A generous benefits program that supports the whole you with medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and 401(k)
* Paid holidays and flexible, take\-it\-as\-you\-need\-it paid time off
* Monthly tech reimbursements
* A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from


**Role Overview:**



As a Team Lead, Website Onboarding, you balance team management with individual contribution. You have expertise in overseeing and coordinating the onboarding process for our service professionals' (our Pros') websites, and use your knowledge to develop and grow others. You strive for excellence in ensuring the efficient and accurate onboarding of clients onto our platform. You consider yourself a leader, have excellent time management skills, and are always looking to improve processes. You bring a strategic mindset, exceptional organizational skills, and empathetic leadership to help better our team and improve the lives of our Pros.



Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our Pros. Our success is their success.


**What you do each day:**


* Supervise and lead a team of website onboarding specialists, providing guidance and support
* Oversee the onboarding process for Pros' websites, ensuring adherence to company standards
* Create templated customer websites with pictures and text by using set templates and design guidelines to deliver web pages that fit their brand
* Leverage AI tools to optimize web build quality, accelerate delivery speed, and drive overall operational efficiency
* Serve as an escalation point for complex client inquiries or issues related to website onboarding
* Conduct regular training sessions for the team to enhance their knowledge and skills in website onboarding
* Analyze performance metrics and provide regular reports to management on team efficiency and client satisfaction
* Stay informed about industry trends, web technologies, and best practices for website development
* Troubleshoot issues that come up during the website build process; sizing, padding, widgets


**Qualifications:**


* 1\+ years experience in administrative work or data input
* 1\+ years experience in full\-time customer facing experience
* 2\+ years experience in creating websites using web design software (i.e. Duda, WordPress, GoDaddy, Squarespace, Canva)
* 1\+ years experience leading or mentoring others
* High School Diploma or equivalent work experience
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to improve workflows, streamline execution, or enhance outputs


**What will help you succeed in this role:**


* Proven leadership experience in guiding a team through the website onboarding process
* Continuous learning and staying updated on changes in web technologies and industry standards
* Demonstrated ability to optimize processes and enhance team efficiency
* Customer\-focused mindset with a dedication to delivering exceptional service
* Exceptional breadth of interest shown through tangible, self\-initiated ventures or deep community involvement; you love trying new things and may possess a demonstrated history of successfully pivoting or starting over in life and work


**Location Dependent Information**



This role is open to candidates and the expected compensation range for this role is $24\.52\-$28\.85/hr base with variable component for $57,600\-$66,600 USD annually. The specific hourly rate for the successful candidate will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible to participate in Housecall Pro's the following benefits: health care insurance (medical, dental, vision, disability), employee assistance program, 401(K), flexible time off, paid parental leave, tech reimbursement, and other company benefits. Housecall Pro is growing fast and we're scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth.


Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy\-to\-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best\-in\-class service.



Housecall Pro's brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.



We support more than 50,000 businesses and have over 2,000 ambitious, mission\-driven, genuinely fun\-loving teammates across the globe. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we'd love to hear from you.


Housecall Pro celebrates diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. \#LI\-Remo
